title: Senior cybersäkerhetsexpert med affärs- och managementfokus
description:
**Vill du arbeta med cybersäkerhet för några av Sveriges mest säkerhetskritiska verksamheter och samtidigt bidra till ett tryggare samhälle? Vi söker erfarna medarbetare till vår enhet Executive Advisory som vill kombinera strategiskt ledarskap, affärsutveckling och avancerad cybersäkerhet i uppdrag som påverkar Sveriges säkerhet på riktigt.**
 Din roll som senior cybersäkerhetexpert
   

  

 För oss är cybersäkerhet inte bara teknik – det är en avgörande del av landets totalförsvar. I denna roll blir du en nyckelperson i att skydda och utveckla samhällsviktig verksamhet, samtidigt som du driver affärer och bygger långsiktiga partnerskap med våra kunder.
   

  

 I rollen som senior konsult inom Executive Advisory är du både expert och affärsdrivande ledare. Du blir del av en mindre enhet bestående av seniora generalister med stark kompetens inom cybersäkerhet, och även inom områden som säkerhetsskydd, strategisk analys, affärsutveckling och management. Du får frihet att forma din roll, påverka våra tjänster och bygga långsiktiga partnerskap utifrån din erfarenhet och kompetensprofil.
   

  

 Du kommer att driva egna kundaffärer från första kontakt till värdeskapande leverans och arbeta aktivt med att identifiera och utveckla nya affärsmöjligheter, både hos befintliga och nya kunder. I ditt ansvar ingår också att säkra beläggning för dig själv och dina kollegor genom proaktivt arbete. I det dagliga leder och stöttar du kunder i utformning och realisering av deras cybersäkerhetsarbete, ger rådgivning till beslutsfattare kring nulägesbedömningar, riskvärderingar, strategiformulering och hur cybersäkerhet kopplas till verksamhetsmål och affärsvärde. Du driver och deltar i komplexa projekt för kunder med höga säkerhetskrav.
   

  

 I den här rollen arbetar du nära våra mest betydelsefulla kunder inom sektorer som försvar, industri, finans, energi och infrastruktur - aktörer som är avgörande för landets försvar och samhällssäkerhet. Ditt arbete är centralt för att integrera cybersäkerhet med kundernas verksamhetsmål och affärsstrategier. Du kommer också att samarbeta med med andra enheter på Combitech för att skapa och leverera helhetslösningar för våra kunder.
   

  

 Vi söker dig som
   

  

 Vi söker dig som kombinerar djup cybersäkerhetskompetens med affärssinne och ledarskap. Vi tror att du har minst tio års erfarenhet av cybersäkerhet, gärna från samhällsviktig verksamhet, samt dokumenterad erfarenhet av affärsutveckling och kundansvar.
   

  

 Du trivs med att arbeta som konsult på heltid och har en förmåga att självständigt driva arbete, ta initiativ och skapa resultat. Rollen kräver också erfarenhet av att leda team och driva komplexa projekt, liksom en förmåga att balansera teknik och verksamhetsförståelse. Du bygger relationer med lätthet och kommunicerar obehindrat på både svenska och engelska. Ett socialt, ödmjukt och prestigelöst sätt att samarbeta är en självklarhet för dig.
   

  

 Certifieringar som CISSP, CISM, CISA, CCP etc. och erfarenhet av ramverk som NIST CSF, ISO27001, CMMC är meriterande. Tidigare roller som CISO, CIO, CSO eller managementkonsult inom cyber är också särskilt intressanta.
   

  

 Placeringsort är främst Stockholm eller Linköping, men andra orter kan vara aktuella för rätt kandidat.
   

  

**Då tjänsten innebär arbete som omfattas av försvarssekretess krävs det att du genomför och godkänns i en säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll.**
**Urval sker löpande. Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!**
 Kom och gör skillnad
   

  

 På Combitech har vi ett löfte: vi investerar i våra medarbetare. Våra kunder förväntar sig att vi ska ligga i absolut framkant och kunna lösa även de svåraste problemen, därför behöver vi ständigt utvecklas, som företag, som team, och som individer.
   

  

 Hos oss har du möjlighet att göra karriär och utmana dig själv som ledare, men också fördjupa din expertis och din domänkunskap. Vi brukar säga att här kan du byta jobb utan att byta arbetsgivare. Du kan arbeta med en mängd olika sektorer, branscher, tekniker, uppdragsgivare och projekt.
   

  

**Vill du veta mer om hur det är att arbeta hos oss? Kolla in** 
**våra karriärsidor!**
**Kontakt:** 
 Henrik Agardh-Twetman, henrik.agardh-twetman@combitech.com
   

  

*Vi undanber oss rekryteringssamarbeten.*

title: IT-samordnare till Järva Stadsdelsförvaltning
description:
**Nu söker vi en IT-samordnare till kanslienheten på Järva Stadsdelsförvaltning. Tilltalas du av en förvaltning i förändring, där du får möjlighet att påverka och utveckla IT-arbetet, så kan detta vara en roll för dig!**
**Välkommen till oss**
 Kanslienheten samlar flera centrala stödfunktioner som ger ett stabilt administrativt och strategiskt stöd till Järva stadsdelsförvaltning. Här ansvarar vi bland annat för nämndsekretariat, registratur, arkiv, informationssäkerhet och dataskydd.
   

  

 Enheten har även ansvar för IT, telefoni och digitalisering och spelar en viktig roll i förvaltningens utvecklingsarbete, med särskilt fokus på effektiva och hållbara IT-lösningar.
   

  

 Idag består kanslienheten av cirka 15 medarbetare och är organiserad i tre funktionsområden, varav IT och telefoni är en.
   

  

**Vi erbjuder dig**
 Här blir du en del av ett engagerat team som trivs tillsammans och har roligt i vardagen. Vi är inne i en spännande förändringsresa där vi tillsammans vidareutvecklar våra arbetssätt, testar nya idéer och hittar smarta lösningar för framtiden.
   

  

 Du blir en del av en stor organisation med verksamhet i två förvaltningshus, vilket skapar möjligheter till samarbete, variation och nytänkande. Rollen passar dig som trivs med att arbeta med support och vägledning till användare, samt värdesätter ordning och reda, även i detaljer som administration och registervård.
   

  

 Hos oss uppmuntras initiativförmåga och nyfikenhet, vi ser gärna att du omvärldsbevakar och bidrar till att förbättra våra arbetssätt över tid.
   

  

 Dessutom erbjuder vi dig:
   

  

* friskvårdsbidrag
* en trygg tillsvidareanställning hos Stockholms stad
* vinter- och sommararbetstid
* goda möjligheter till utveckling
* ett varierande arbete och en stark teamgemenskap där vi stöttar varandra.


 Läs mer om våra förmåner här
   

  

**En varm hälsning från din framtida chef**
 ”Jag heter Josefine Rogel Randin och är din blivande chef. Jag arbetar aktivt för att vara en tillgänglig och stöttande ledare. Jag drivs av att ständigt förbättra arbetet inom enhetens ansvarsområden. Jag har stort förtroende för mina medarbetare och jag jobbar för en sund arbetsmiljö där alla får möjlighet att bidra till verksamhetens bästa.”
   

  

**Din roll**
 Som IT-samordnare på kanslienheten har du en central roll i förvaltningens IT-arbete och ansvarar för att samordna, utveckla och stödja verksamheten inom IT och telefoni. Rollen är bred och varierad och innebär både nära samarbete med kollegor inom IT-teamet, där uppdrag planeras och fördelas gemensamt, samt ett självständigt ansvar för att driva och genomföra egna arbetsuppgifter. Du blir en del av en stadsdelsförvaltning med tydligt fokus på utveckling och ingår i ett team som arbetar med IT, telefoni och digitaliseringsfrågor. Tillsammans driver vi utvecklingen framåt och stöttar varandra för att nå gemensamma mål.
   

  

 I dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter ingår:
   

  

* ansvar för all IT och telefoni inom förvaltningen, inklusive administration och behörighetshantering
* support och vägledning till användare, med ett pedagogiskt fokus på att skapa förutsättningar för självhjälp
* upphandling och beställning av olika IT-tjänster, såsom till exempel datorer, skrivare, servrar och mobiltelefoner
* implementering av nya system, installation och ominstallation av digitala enheter samt vid behov samordna utbyten av digitala enheter
* koordinering av datakommunikation och nätverkstrafik
* vara spindeln i nätet med god helhetssyn över både stadsdelsförvaltningens och stadens IT-arbete
* operativt ansvar med deltagande i strategiska IT-frågor.


**Din kompetens och erfarenhet**
 Vi söker dig som har:
   

  

* yrkeshögskola med inriktning mot IT eller med motsvarande aktuell kompetens från arbete i liknande roller
* aktuell arbetslivserfarenhet inom IT-support med fokus på användarstöd, telefoni, samordning (med förmåga att kunna översätta IT-språk till verksamheten)
* erfarenhet av felsökning inom IT (bl.a server, klient och nätverk)
* goda kunskaper i officepaketet
* god kommunikativ förmåga på svenska, både i tal och skrift.


 Det är meriterande om du ha erfarenhet av:
   

  

* EK-SITHS administration och telefonisamordning
* outsourcad IT-miljö
* arbete inom eller på uppdrag för servicedesk inom offentlig verksamhet.


 Vi lägger stor vikt vid följande personliga kompetenser:
   

  

 Du är
 **kommunikativ** 
 och uttrycker dig väl, anpassar din kommunikation efter olika målgrupper och situationer. Du är
 **serviceinriktad** 
 och sätter användarnas behov i centrum, alltid redo att ge bästa möjliga stöd. Med god
 **samarbetsförmåga** 
 trivs du att arbeta tillsammans med kollegor och andra delar av organisationen för att nå gemensamma mål. Dessutom är du
 **flexibel** 
 och anpassar dig lätt till förändringar i en dynamisk arbetsmiljö.
   

  

**Övrigt**
 I denna rekryteringsprocess kan tester komma att tillämpas i urvalsprocessen.

title: Information Security Engineer Lead
description:
**Mission**
 Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.
   

  

 In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.
   

  

**Job Title:** 
 Information Security Engineering Lead
   

  

**Location:** 
 Stockholm, London, or Berlin
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Full-time
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 Our Security team works to create and maintain the safest environment for Neko's members and developers. We embed security into the entire product lifecycle, from initial design and think-it through launch and beyond. In this role, you will also work with and lead software engineers to proactively identify and fix security flaws and vulnerabilities, conduct in-depth security reviews throughout the product lifecycle, build security capabilities into CI/CD pipelines, and improve detection.
   

  

**What You'll Deliver In The First 6-12 Months**
* Conduct security reviews, research and reproduce vulnerabilities, design secure protocols and systems, and write tests and fuzzers.
* Review and develop secure operational practices and provide security guidance for engineers and staff.
* Assess designs and look for vulnerabilities, both with launch reviews and longer-term engagements.
* Look for vulnerabilities with techniques including but not limited to AI, manual code review, fuzzing, and static code analysis.
* Perform threat modelling of large and complex systems to quickly determine areas that warrant further investigation and direct security review.
* Leverage AI tools and agents in your day-to-day work to scale your own capabilities.
* Hardening and securing cloud infrastructures


**Minimum Qualifications**
* 5 years of experience with security assessments, security design reviews, or security engineering.
* Experience in one or more general purpose languages, preferably C#, Python, C++, Javascript or Java.
* Experience with cloud infrastructures like Azure, GCP or AWS


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 10 years of experience with security assessments, security design reviews, or security engineering.
* Understanding both offensive and defensive security methods.
* Experience in three or more general purpose languages, preferably C#, Python, C++, Javascript or Java.
* Good knowledge and experience with breaking and securing cloud infrastructures like Azure, GCP or AWS

title: Senior Project Manager – SAP Infrastructure Transformation / Azure Migration
description:
We are seeking a highly experienced
 **Senior Project Manager** 
 to lead and govern a strategic
 **SAP infrastructure transformation and Microsoft Azure migration program** 
 .
   

  

 The program involves migrating a complex enterprise SAP landscape from an existing data-center environment to
 **Microsoft Azure** 
 . An external delivery partner will be responsible for much of the technical implementation, while the Senior Project Manager will act as the
 **primary client-side representative** 
 , ensuring strong governance, business alignment, stakeholder coordination, risk management, and successful delivery throughout the program lifecycle.
   

  

 The assignment operates under a
 **flexible hybrid working model** 
 , with an expected on-site presence of approximately
 **three days per week** 
 , subject to agreement.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Act as the primary client-side representative throughout the SAP infrastructure migration program.
* Serve as the main interface toward external delivery partners, system integrators, vendors, and key stakeholders.
* Establish and maintain effective program/project governance, reporting, escalation, risk management, and decision-making structures.
* Coordinate SAP, infrastructure, cloud, security, application, business, and operational teams across multiple countries.
* Ensure technical migration activities remain aligned with business objectives, priorities, security requirements, and operational needs.
* Develop and maintain integrated project plans covering milestones, dependencies, resources, budgets, risks, issues, and key deliverables.
* Lead steering committees, management reviews, executive reporting, and key decision forums.
* Manage dependencies between SAP applications, infrastructure, cloud services, security, networks, integrations, and business processes.
* Oversee migration and cutover planning, testing, business readiness, go-live activities, stabilization, and transition to operations.
* Ensure appropriate contingency, rollback, disaster-recovery, and business-continuity planning.
* Drive issue resolution and proactively identify and mitigate risks affecting scope, schedule, cost, quality, or business continuity.
* Ensure compliance with applicable security, operational, governance, and regulatory requirements.
* Ensure effective handover to operations and appropriate documentation and service-readiness activities.


**Required Qualifications & Experience**
* 10–15+ years of Project/Program Management experience, preferably leading large-scale enterprise IT transformation programs.
* Proven track record managing complex SAP infrastructure, hosting, migration, or modernization programs.
* Strong experience with enterprise SAP environments and technologies such as:
+ SAP ECC
+ SAP S/4HANA
+ SAP BW
+ SAP PI/PO
+ SAP BTP
+ Related SAP infrastructure and integration technologies

* Demonstrated experience leading or overseeing SAP migrations from on-premises/traditional data centers to Microsoft Azure.
* Strong understanding of cloud migration methodologies and infrastructure modernization.
* Knowledge of high availability, disaster recovery, business continuity, cutover, testing, and operational readiness.
* Strong experience managing global system integrators, outsourced service providers, and external technology vendors.
* Proven ability to manage complex project plans, budgets, dependencies, risks, issues, and executive-level reporting.
* Excellent stakeholder management, leadership, communication, negotiation, and escalation-management skills.
* Experience coordinating global and cross-functional teams across business and technology organizations.
* Strong understanding of Agile, Waterfall, and/or hybrid project delivery models.
* Ability to operate effectively in complex, international, and highly regulated enterprise environments.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Extensive previous experience with Microsoft Azure migration programs involving enterprise-scale SAP landscapes.
* SAP certification and/or Microsoft Azure certification.
* Experience working within large multinational organizations, particularly across the Nordic region.
* Knowledge of ITIL, IT service management, operational transition, and service-readiness processes.
* Experience with major SAP transformation, infrastructure modernization, data-center exit, or cloud-adoption programs.

title: Penetration tester
description:
Vill du arbeta i ett Red Team där medarbetarna har lång erfarenhet och spetskompetens inom flera områden, och där du får möjlighet att fördjupa dina egna kunskaper ytterligare? Vi söker nu en Red Team Operator som vill vara med och planera, genomföra och utveckla våra red team-uppdrag hos några av landets mest spännande kunder. Här får du arbeta hands-on med allt från förberedelser och infrastrukturbygge till rapportering och kundpresentationer samtidigt som du bidrar med din erfarenhet i att coacha och vägleda kollegor.
 



  





**Om tjänsten** 




 Som Red Team Operator arbetar du i hela kedjan av red team-uppdrag, från planering och genomförande till uppföljning, i nära samarbete med kollegor. Du har en ledande roll i leveransen där du stöttar och coachar juniora kollegor samt bidrar till att säkerställa hög kvalitet i utförda uppdrag. Rollen innebär också att du har möjlighet att påverka teamets metodik, verktyg och arbetssätt samt vara med och forma hur vi tar oss an några av Sveriges mest komplexa och affärskritiska säkerhetsutmaningar.
 



  





 Du kommer även att:
 


* Förbereda infrastruktur, hårdvara och verktyg inför uppdrag
* Dokumentera och presentera resultat för kunder på olika nivåer, både tekniskt och strategiskt
* Bidra i säljprocesser genom att paketera tjänster, skriva offerter och sätta pris



  





 Du blir en del av vårt Red Team tillsammans med åtta kollegor på olika senioritetsnivåer, ett tight gäng som stöttar, utmanar och lär av varandra varje dag. Här får du arbeta i en miljö med högt i tak där din erfarenhet värdesätts och dina idéer får utrymme. Vi lägger stor vikt vid kvalitet, kunskapsdelning och långsiktiga resultat, och du får möjlighet att utvecklas, ha kul på vägen och göra konkret skillnad för våra kunder.
 



  





**Vem vi söker** 




 För att passa i tjänsten som Red Team Operator söker vi dig som är självgående, engagerad och strukturerad. Du är trygg i att fatta beslut även när inte all information finns på bordet, och du trivs i att coacha andra och bidra till lagets utveckling. Samtidigt är du en lagspelare som gärna delar med dig av din kunskap och skapar energi i gruppen. Vi värderar inställning lika högt som kompetens och söker dig som är engagerad, teamorienterad och drivs av att göra skillnad.
 



  





 Vi ser gärna att du har:
 


* Minst 5 års erfarenhet som pentester, med bred erfarenhet av olika kundmiljöer (exempelvis AD, moln och applikationer)
* God förståelse för informationssäkerhet och regelverk som NIS, GDPR, DORA och TIBER
* Förmåga att skriva tydliga rekommendationer och kommunicera tekniskt innehåll på både teknisk och strategisk nivå
* Relevant certifiering, gärna OSCP, OSEP, GPEN, GxPEN eller liknande (meriterande med CISSP)
* Flytande svenska och engelska i tal och skrift



  





 Vi tror att du är en kommunikativ och strukturerad person med ett coachande förhållningssätt. Du vågar lyfta frågor, delar generöst med dig av din kunskap och stöttar dina kollegor – samtidigt som du bidrar till en lagkultur där vi utvecklas och utmanar varandra på ett schysst sätt. Det är också en fördel om du har erfarenhet av att arbeta nära affärskritiska miljöer och är van att presentera på ledningsnivå.
 



  





**Ansökan** 




 Skicka din ansökan genom att klicka på knappen ”Join us!” under annonsen. Skicka gärna din ansökan snarast då urvalet sker löpande, dock senast 30/9. Vi tar inte emot ansökningar via mejl p.g.a. GDPR. Kontakta gärna Emma Persson, Talent Acquisition & People Partner på epr@cparta.se om du har några frågor om tjänsten.
 



  





 Välkommen med din ansökan!
 



  





 Erbjudanden från rekryteringsföretag/annonssäljare undanbedes.

title: Security Engineer, Solna/Hybrid
description:
Do you want to be part of a dynamic and challenging environment at the number one logistics services provider in Scandinavia? If you have a passion for cyber security and are interested in solving complex problems, join us in protecting our infrastructure that serves millions across the Nordics.
   

  

 If you have a passion for security and are interested in developing our platforms and solving complex problems, come and join us as our Security Engineer at PostNord in Solna.
   

  

**Join us**
 The CISO Office at PostNord Group houses is responsible for protecting the business, enabling digital transformation and earning trust. We work very closely with the enterprise architects, network and system administrators, developers, privacy officers and production engineers to name a few; on a journey to further expand our information security capabilities. Our information security program is driven by a risk-based approach, rather than a compliance-based approach followed by highly regulated industries.
   

  

**Job Duties**
 In the role of Security Engineer, you will work within our Security Operations team to ensure effective operation of cyber security incident logging & monitoring, incident response and vulnerability management.
   

  

**You Will Work With, Among Other Things**
* Assist in effective operation of cybersecurity incident response process and streamline response to common attacks.
* Coordinate cybersecurity incident response within the PostNord Group.
* Implement and maintain modern SIEM (Azure Sentinel) to unify visibility across PostNord Group.
* Reduce manual effort by using automated investigation, remediation and response playbooks.
* Ensure alert quality, design and implement proactive threat hunting processes.
* Perform / assist in threat hunting, forensic investigations, analysing alerts and assessing vulnerabilities.
* Prioritize vulnerabilities and coordinate remediation efforts.


 Several years of experience as an IT security specialist in a medium to large enterprise company. You have been driving changes and projects and understand how it is done within a larger organisation.
   

  

 Open minded person that is curious and social and finds it natural to share knowledge with your fellowcolleagues. Can visualise problems and present them both in a technical and executive way.
   

  

**Requirements And Technical Skills**
* Hands-on experience with Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) systems and Security Operations Centres (SOC).
* In-depth understanding of IT Security principles with strong capabilities in investigating and resolving security incidents.
* Ability to visualize complex problems and present solutions both technically and to executive stakeholders.
* Proficiency in various security tools and technologies, including Microsoft Defender suite and Microsoft Purview.
* Knowledge of vulnerability management principles and severity ratings.
* Experience with regulatory compliance and cybersecurity frameworks such as NIST, ISO 27001, and GDPR.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a methodical approach to tasks.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to convey technical information to non-technical audiences.
* Ability to handle confidential information with integrity and discretion.
* Familiarity with incident response procedures and disaster recovery planning.


 We believe you are a person that is thorough, analytical, and easy to get acquainted with and learn new systems. You have a structured, responsible, and inclusive way of working. You need to be able to handle stressful situations and prioritize job tasks independently. You are communicative and easy to collaborate with and are unpretentious in your ways of creating and nurturing long-term relationships.
   

  

**We offer you**
**Benefits**
 We offer a variety of work in an international environment with constantly new challenges and quick decisions. Here you have opportunities to develop creative solutions and work in a prestige-free group where we jointly help to reach our goals. PostNord is one of Sweden's largest workplaces and we offer safe employment conditions and benefits. In addition to the benefits mentioned above, we offer:
   

  

* Hybrid workplace with a Nordic and dynamic environment. Watch the video about our office.
* Great development opportunities
* Great insurance and occupational pension terms
* Wellness allowance & opportunity to train at Arken's gym and indoor swimming pool
* Employee benefits through PostNord Plus - PostNord´s own personnel foundation


**We make everyday life easier**
 PostNord is the leading supplier of communication and logistics solutions to, from, and within the Nordic region. We ensure the provision of a postal service to households and businesses in Sweden and Denmark. We aim to make everyday life easier and more sustainable for everyone who lives and works in the Nordic region. We are in a constant transformation and work consistently to develop both our offer and our employees, all to achieve our vision of being The favorite carrier of the Nordics. We are PostNord - a fantastic company to work and grow with. Read more at postnord.com
   

  

**Apply**
 We look forward to receive your application!
   

  

 Don't wait to submit your application as we go through the applications on an ongoing basis.
   

  

 For union representatives, visit: www.postnord.com/fackliga
   

  

 We are looking forward to hear from you!

title: Systemingenjör inom Terminalsystem till LFV
description:
Vi leder flyget - i takt med tiden, i alla lägen. LFV är Sveriges ledande aktör inom flygtrafikledning för civil och militär luftfart med tillhörande tjänster. Vi erbjuder flygtrafikledning och relaterade tjänster både nationellt och internationellt. Våra flygledare leder dagligen cirka 2 000 flygplan i svenskt luftrum. LFV var först i världen med flygtrafikledning på distans och vi driver digitaliseringen inom flera områden. Genom olika samarbeten är vi med och effektiviserar det europeiska luftrummet. Läs mer om LFV, www.lfv.se.
   

  

 Vill du kombinera teknikintresse med ett meningsfullt uppdrag? Tycker du dessutom att det låter spännande att arbeta med IT och teknisk utrustning i en flygplatsmiljö? Då kan detta vara jobbet för dig! LFV söker nu systemingenjörer med fokus på terminalsystem med placering på Arlanda.
   

  

 Hos LFV får du möjlighet att ta ett helhetsansvar för viktiga system i en verksamhet där din kompetens gör skillnad varje dag.
   

  

**Om rollen**
 Som systemingenjör arbetar du med drift, underhåll, förvaltning och utveckling av tekniska system och tillhörande hårdvara, exempelvis incheckningssystem och informationsskärmar som används operativt i terminalerna. Arbetet kräver bland annat installation, felsökning och testning av hård- och mjukvara. De flesta systemen körs i Windows-miljö, men du kommer även i kontakt med Linux.
   

  

 Du är placerad på Arlanda men resor till andra orter kan förekomma. Arbetstiden är dagtid, 07:30–16:00, och rollen innefattar beredskapstjänst.
   

  

**Vem är du?**
 För att lyckas i rollen har du erfarenhet av IT-arbete, exempelvis som nätverksadministratör, nätverkstekniker, systemtekniker eller supporttekniker. Du är van att arbeta i både Windows- och Linuxmiljö och har en relevant gymnasieutbildning i grunden. Vidare har du god förståelse för nätverk och servermiljö, kan dokumentera tekniska lösningar på svenska och engelska och är bekväm att arbeta självständigt såväl som i projekt. Manuellt B-körkort är ett krav.
   

  

 Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av Linux-serverdrift, SCCM och applikationspaketering, Active Directory och policyhantering, samt om du har högskoleutbildning, certifieringar eller erfarenhet av ITIL och andra förvaltningsmodeller.
   

  

 Vi söker dig som drivs av utveckling, är strukturerad och ansvarsfull samt trivs i en roll där ordning och reda är en självklarhet. Du är trygg i dig själv, delar gärna med dig av din kunskap och uppskattar att samarbeta med andra för att nå gemensamma mål. Din problemlösningsförmåga gör att du ser möjligheter även i utmanande situationer.
   

  

**Övrig information**
 Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning med placeringsort Stockholm.
   

  

 Innan anställning genomför LFV en säkerhetsprövning som bland annat innefattar registerkontroll, säkerhetsintervju och drogtest. Denna tjänst kräver svenskt medborgarskap. Som anställd hos oss kommer du arbeta i en spännande bransch som ständigt utvecklas genom teknik, forskning och internationella samarbeten. Vidare får du en trygg och marknadsmässig anställning med bra förmåner som t ex utökad semester, företagshälsovård och förmånliga pensionsvillkor.
   

  

**Kontakt:**
 I den här rekryteringen samarbetar LFV med Poolia. Vi tar inte emot ansökan på mail pga GDPR och vi vill ha ditt cv på svenska. Vid frågor är du välkommen att kontakta ansvarig rekryteringskonsult Sofie Cardegren, 073 344 71 76, sofie.cardegren@poolia.se.

title: Full-Stack Engineer - Survey & Design
description:
*10% of Europe’s CO₂ emissions are caused by residential heating and energy bills are out of control. Aira is here to change that.*
*With our intelligent Aira Heat Pump at the heart, we’re making the switch to clean energy-tech easier and more affordable. Helping Europe turn off gas and slashing energy costs one home at a time.*
*Founded in 2022, and with 1200+ employees and counting, Aira is driving the clean energy revolution by providing homes with modern clean energy-tech solutions such as solar power, battery storage solutions and heat pumps. With a state-of-the-art production facility in Poland, and HQ in Stockholm, Sweden, and hubs across the UK, Germany and Italy, Aira is well on track to install clean energy-tech into 5 million homes by 2034.*
**About The Role**
 As a Full-Stack Engineer in our Survey & Design team, you'll help build the products that support some of the most important steps in Aira's customer acquisition journey.
   

  

 The team is responsible for the tools used to capture and manage information about our customers' homes, supporting everything from home surveys and technical assessments to installation design. These products help ensure that the right information is available throughout the process, enabling tailored and efficient clean energy solutions.
   

  

 You'll join a small, autonomous product team and work closely with product managers, designers and engineers to solve real-world challenges and build scalable solutions that support Aira's continued growth across Europe.
   

  

 As a Full-Stack Engineer, you'll play a key role in shaping the products and services that power these workflows. You'll work across the stack to build scalable solutions and great user experiences.
   

  

***In this role, you will***
* Design and build applications and services that support users across multiple European markets
* Develop scalable APIs and integrations with third-party systems
* Process and manage data collected throughout the Survey & Design journey
* Transform complex technical and geometric data into solutions that support our products and workflows
* Contribute to architectural decisions and the long-term evolution of the platform
* Collaborate closely with product managers, designers and end users to improve workflows, user experiences and product capabilities
* Explore new technologies and approaches that help solve real business problems


 We're making home energy design smarter, simpler and more scalable. If you enjoy building great products and solving complex problems in a technically challenging domain, this role is for you.
   

  

**What You'll Bring To The Team**
* Around 5+ years of experience as a Software Engineer
* Experience building modern software applications across different parts of the stack
* Strong experience with Java and Spring Boot
* Experience designing and building APIs
* A solid understanding of databases, software architecture and distributed systems
* Experience working with microservices
* The ability to turn ideas into clean, testable and scalable software
* A proactive mindset and willingness to take ownership
* Strong collaboration and communication skills


 We believe you'll thrive in this role if you're curious, analytical and enjoy understanding the real-world challenges behind the software you build. You don't need a background in engineering, but an interest in technical domains and complex problem-solving will help you succeed.
   

  

 We're also looking for someone who enjoys learning new technologies and is curious about how emerging technologies, including AI, can create value for both products and ways of working.
   

  

*Our tech stack:*
 Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Kafka, gRPC, Kotlin, Python, React, TypeScript, Next.js, Kubernetes and Docker.
   

  

***What is in it for you?***
* Join a mission-driven company accelerating the transition to clean energy across Europe
* Work on products that have a direct impact on how clean energy solutions are designed and delivered
* Be part of a small, highly autonomous team with significant influence on product and technical decisions
* Collaborate with talented colleagues across product, engineering and operations
* Grow professionally in a fast-moving and international environment
* Enjoy our brand-new office at Norra Stationsgatan 93 in Stockholm. Conveniently located near public transport, with Sankt Eriksplan and Odenplan stations just a few minutes walk away.


 At Aira, we champion next-generation energy as well as diversity and inclusion. We firmly believe that a diverse workforce fosters innovation and creativity, enhancing our ability to serve customers and communities effectively. We welcome individuals from all backgrounds, cultures and perspectives to join our team. Our commitment is to uphold equality and inclusivity, fostering a collaborative environment where everyone can thrive and contribute to a better future for our people and the planet.

title: Senior Säkerhetsanalytiker
description:
Vill du arbeta nära verkliga hot och vara med och göra skillnad för att skydda svenska företag? Hos oss får du arbeta med kvalificerad säkerhetsanalys, incidenthantering, threat hunting och detektionsutveckling.
 



  





 Nu söker vi ytterligare en säkerhetsanalytiker. Rollen passar dig som redan har praktisk erfarenhet av IT-säkerhet och vill arbeta i en operativ roll. Tillsammans med kollegor utvecklar du både det dagliga säkerhetsarbetet och vår långsiktiga försvarsförmåga.
 



  





**Om tjänsten** 




 Som säkerhetsanalytiker hos oss blir du en del av ett team där analytiker med olika spetskompetenser arbetar nära varandra i varierande uppdrag. Här får du också vara med och forma vår framtida SOC genom att utveckla nya och befintliga produkter, processer och rutiner.
 



  





 Du kommer bland annat att arbeta med att:
 


* Analysera, prioritera och hantera larm från EDR/XDR och NDR.
* Hantera säkerhetsincidenter, från initial triagering och analys till avgränsning, åtgärdsrekommendationer och dokumenterad slutsats.
* Genomföra threat hunting och proaktivt identifiera hot, risker och avvikande beteenden.
* Bidra till utveckling av detektionsregler, use cases, playbooks och arbetssätt.



  





**Vem vi söker** 




 Vi söker dig som har flera års praktisk erfarenhet av operativ IT-säkerhet. Du är trygg med både tekniskt arbete och kommunikation med kunder. Du trivs i ett team där man samarbetar, delar kunskap och gemensamt driver arbetet framåt. Samtidigt är du självgående, tar ansvar och är bekväm med att fatta egna beslut.
 



  





 För den här rollen behöver du:
 


* Ha erfarenhet av arbete inom cybersäkerhet, exempelvis SOC, blue team, incidenthantering eller säkerhetsövervakning.
* Ha praktisk erfarenhet av SIEM-verktyg och logganalys.
* Ha god förståelse för nätverksdata, nätverksprotokoll och nätverksrelaterad säkerhet.
* Kunna kommunicera tekniska fynd på ett användbart sätt och uttrycka dig väl på svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.



  





 Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av något av följande:
 


* Threat hunting och hypotesdriven analys
* Detektionsutveckling och arbete med detektionslogik
* Threat intelligence och underrättelsedrivet försvarsarbete
* Microsoft säkerhetsplattformar, såsom Microsoft Defender EDR/XDR, Cloud Apps och Sentinel.
* KQL, EQL, SPL, Sigma, YARA eller motsvarande språk och detektionsformat
* Forensisk analys, malwareanalys eller reverse engineering
* Skriptning och automation
* Molnsäkerhet i Azure, AWS eller GCP



  





**Ansökan** 




 Skicka din ansökan genom att klicka på knappen ”Join us!” under annonsen. Skicka gärna din ansökan snarast då urvalet sker löpande, dock senast 30/9 Vi tar inte emot ansökningar via mejl p.g.a. GDPR. Kontakta gärna Edward Hamilton, Blue Manager, på
 **eha@cparta.se** 
 om du har några frågor om tjänsten.
 



  





 Välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Solution Architect - Infrastructure Data Center Transformation , Presales - Stockholm, Amsterdam, London, Frankfurt
description:
**Role: Infrastructure Data Center Transformation Solution Architect / Presales**
**Role Designation: Principal Consultant**
**Career Stream: Pre-sales / Solutions**
**Career SubStream: Technical, Techno commercial**
**Location – Amsterdam, Frankfurt, Germany, London (Any EMEA location)**
 As a Solution Architect focused on Infrastructure Data Center Transformation Solutions / Presales, the role owns the creation of strong, differentiated and commercially viable infrastructure solutions across data center modernization, private and hybrid cloud, virtualization, HPC, CaaS, Infra for AI, AI POD and AI Factory-led transformation. The role plays the technical architect and integrated solution owner across pursuits, translating Infosys capabilities into client-ready solution constructs and vendor/client price book patterns while bringing together Data center, Network, Cyber, Cloud and MS threads into one coherent end-to-end proposal. The role is expected to combine deep technical architecture skills with strong techno-commercial judgment, partner ecosystem understanding, solution pricing awareness, and AI-led differentiation to shape winning solutions in compliance with Infosys guidelines, policies and norms.
   

  

**Additional Requirements**
 Demonstrated experience in Infrastructure Data Center Transformation, Solution Architecture and Presales, with expertise across Data Center, Private and Hybrid Cloud, Network, Cyber, Managed Services, ITSM, automation and AI-enabled infrastructure solutions. The role must have at least one primary and one secondary area of specialization, with the ability to design integrated, multi-tower solutions and translate technical solution components into vendor and client pricing constructs, bill of materials, assumptions, commercials and price book patterns.
   

  

**Areas of Responsibility**
* Business Planning


 Performs the analysis of services, products and technologies under guidance to provide input on the service offering and input on suitable customers for pursuits.
   

  

* Marketing & Branding


 Evangelizes Infosys Tech Brand in specific areas (e.g., anchoring Tech Day, white papers, speaking in forums, etc.); Builds artifacts in new areas of competency to build collateral and Go-To-Market solutions.
   

  

* Prospecting


 Identifies opportunities in accounts or new technology areas and provides necessary credentials to support the Client Services team in prospecting.
   

  

* Proposals


 Leads infrastructure transformation proposals as the solution architect and integrated solution owner; writes strong, differentiated solution responses, owns the solution storyline, validates solution fitment, and brings together Data center, Network, Cyber, Cloud and MS workstreams into a single coherent pursuit. Provides domain technical consultation to Pre-Sales, participates in proposal discussions, client workshops and solution reviews, architects and validates complex technical solutions, performs estimations and price book mapping, and brings alliance offerings, Infosys IP and AI-led differentiators into the solution.
   

  

* Alliance


 Interacts with vendors and alliances to understand complementary offerings, products, IP, reference architectures, sizing models and commercial constructs. Translates Infosys solution requirements into vendor bill of material and pricing patterns, and converts vendor constructs back into client-facing solution and price book structures with clear assumptions, dependencies and value differentiation.
   

  

* Contracting & Agreement


 Provides technical and techno-commercial inputs for contracting and deal negotiations, including solution assumptions, dependencies, exclusions, SLAs, service outcomes, transition approach, tooling, AI automation commitments, partner dependencies and pricing guardrails in consulting and managed services contractual documents.
   

  

* Project Scoping


 Organizes, documents, and reviews work items' scope from a technical viewpoint and approach to ensure completeness and consistency in scoping of the project.
   

  

* Estimation


 Reviews and validates estimates for consulting projects and guides estimation for complex projects IN ORDER TO ensure correct sizing of the work.
   

  

* Resource Planning


 Provides and reviews inputs on various competencies important for forming teams for projects to address resource competency requirements for the project.
   

  

* Scheduling


 Provides consulting inputs/insight into the complexity of architectural requirements; Reviews work breakdown structure & resources/task/activity planning, sets milestones and deliverables to ensure correctness and optimal scheduling of the project.
   

  

* Quality Planning


 Reviews and validates the target metrics of a project from a technology perspective like tools usage, reusable frameworks, and feasibility to assist in achieving the quality target.
   

  

* Risk Planning


 Reviews, identifies, and prioritizes technical risks to develop a risk mitigation plan.
   

  

* Project Plan Review


 Participates in project plan reviews and provides inputs to ensure accuracy of the plan.
   

  

* Problem Definition


 Participates in customer discussions in various stages of the consulting engagement to understand the problems faced by the customer and articulates the same to the internal stakeholders; Defines and documents the problem and gets customer agreement. Brings in best practices in the industry to in identifying and defining the problem.
   

  

* Requirements Gathering


 Ensures and reviews that the business/technical requirements are understood and translated to system requirements (product requirements) consistent with frameworks/standards to meet requirements definition for products and large projects.
   

  

* Diagnostic Discovery/As-Is Assessment


 Participates in or Conducts workshops to understand the As-Is process/system study and identify high-level process/system changes to arrive at proposed requirements, process maps, fit-gap analysis, and requirements/assessment documents that are agreeable to the customer.
   

  

* Solution Evaluation and Recommendation


 Provides inputs to the customer solution roadmap as the SME in the domain with possible solution alternatives that factor in gap realization, impact on related functional/technical areas, feasibility, and efficiency to assist in arriving at the final solution definition.
   

  

* Strategy & Road Map Definition


 Performs As-Is analysis and provides To-Be recommendations, evaluates product technology solutions, and provides solutions to specialized problems to provide inputs on the technical and domain road map.
   

  

* Architecture


 Acts as the technical architect for pursuits and transformation engagements; creates, consults and reviews architecture decisions across compute, storage, network, cyber, cloud, managed services, virtualization, HPC, CaaS and AI infrastructure domains. Produces solution blueprints, reference architectures and migration patterns that embed AI-led operations, automation, observability, resiliency and FinOps/commercial optimization.
   

  

* Design and Product/Solution Development


 Evaluates and reviews design frameworks, methodologies and solution building blocks, and owns the integrated solution design across towers. Ensures functional and non-functional alignment, commercial feasibility, technology fitment, partner alignment, AI-enabled automation opportunities and clear mapping of Infosys solution components to client-consumable value propositions and pricing structures.
   

  

* Development/Build


 Conducts NFR (non-functional requirement) compliance verifications; validates NFR compliance; ensures alignment with overall architecture view; creates/develops reference codes. Provides consultation to TLs (Team Leads) on complex coding and technical/product issues to ensure effective solution development.
   

  

* Testing


 Provides consultation to TLs on test strategy and solutions, develops test strategy for complex testing requirements, and sets complex multi-vendor, multi-platform testing environments to achieve effective validation.
   

  

* Implementation


 Validates/reviews large/complex deployment solutions & frameworks and creates the blueprint for large deployment solutions IN ORDER TO meet technical challenges in deployment.
   

  

* Knowledge Management


 Evangelizes the usage of reusable frameworks and artifacts, creates knowledge/certification artifacts and evaluation criteria, and guides or provides technical training in relevant technology areas to develop talent in technology/domain.
   

  

* Post Implementation Support


 Resolves critical issues coming at live sites; identifies and fixes critical architectural/framework issues related to the product to meet SLA (Service Level Agreement) requirements during warranty.
   

  

* People Management


 Creates knowledge/certification artifacts and evaluation criteria, mentors in building new areas of competency, guides or provides technical training in relevant technology areas, assists in employees' career planning, and conducts technical interviews to develop talent in technology/domain.
   

  

* Financial Management


 Understands infrastructure transformation pricing models, vendor commercials, license/subscription constructs, consumption patterns, unit pricing, managed services cost drivers and price book structures. Supports solution-level revenue, margin and profitability analysis, validates commercial assumptions, and ensures technical choices are aligned with deal economics and client value outcomes.
   

  

* Client Management


 Leads technical and techno-commercial discussions with customer SMEs, enterprise architects, infrastructure leaders and procurement stakeholders. Articulates Infosys technical differentiation, AI-led transformation value, solution trade-offs, pricing rationale and delivery confidence in a way that supports pursuit progression and client decision-making.
   

  

* Unit/Org Activities


 Assists in the creation of solutions and other IP artifacts, evangelizes the Infosys Tech Brand in specific areas (e.g., anchoring Tech Day, white papers, speaking in forums) to strengthen competency/expertise in technology/domain.). Consulting Practice development
   

  

**Areas Of Responsibility – Additional Requirements**
 Broad-based knowledge of infrastructure platforms, partner products, reference architectures and commercial models across data center transformation, private/hybrid cloud, network, cyber, managed services and AI-enabled infrastructure domains.
   

  

* Ability to define complex, AI-enabled infrastructure architectures and anchor solution reviews across data center, cloud, network, cyber and managed services towers.
* Strong appreciation of consulting, presales, solutioning and pricing frameworks, including assumptions, dependency mapping, effort models, vendor bill of material and client price book alignment.
* Strong customer, vendor, alliance and internal stakeholder management skills, with the ability to lead pursuits and integrate inputs from Data center, Network, Cyber, Cloud and MS teams.
* Ability to leverage domain knowledge and AI-first solution thinking to solve business and IT problems from a technology, operating model and commercial perspective, while switching context across multiple infrastructure services.
* Contribute to thought leadership participate in calls relationship with analysts in her/his focus areas
* Identify and create printable artifacts guides and author papers
* Help seniors in appraisals of juniors and career aspiration program and maintaining of technical discussions with customer technology experts to provide technical differentiation.


**Must-Have Skills / Key Competencies**
* Pre-Sales & Solution Leadership: Proven expertise in pre-sales, infrastructure transformation architecture, and leading large-scale deals within the Data Center Transformation domain, including end-to-end solution design spanning DC network, security, and platform services.
* Cross-Industry Transformation Experience: Extensive experience in delivering data center infrastructure transformation and consulting across multiple industry verticals, enabling well-rounded, cross-domain solutioning.
* Enterprise & Cross-Domain Architecture: Strong enterprise architecture capabilities with a deep understanding of multi-technology integration across infrastructure layers, ensuring cohesive and future-ready solutions.
* Techno-Commercial Acumen: Demonstrated ability to balance technical excellence with commercial viability, shaping competitive and value-driven data center transformation solutions.
* Stakeholder Collaboration & Transformation Consulting: Strong consulting mindset with proven ability to engage client stakeholders and internal teams, ensuring seamless integration during transformation and consolidation programs.
* Communication & Expectation Management: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a focus on stakeholder alignment, transparency, and effective expectation management throughout the transformation lifecycle.
* Partner solution: Leverage partnerships with HPE, Dell, Equinix and other DC providers, Hitachi, Veeam, Commvault, NVIDIA and relevant cloud, virtualization, AI infrastructure and cyber ecosystem partners to bring best-in-class solutions. The role must be able to map partner technologies into Infosys-led AI-enabled propositions, including optimized hardware, GPU and accelerated compute, hybrid cloud options, AI-ready storage, data protection, resiliency, automation and managed services constructs. Partner lists are subject to change.


**About Infosys**
 Infosys is a global leader in next-generation digital services and consulting. We enable clients in 59 countries to navigate their digital transformation.
   

  

 With over four decades of experience in managing the systems and workings of global enterprises, we expertly steer clients, in 59 countries, as they navigate their digital transformation powered by cloud and AI. We enable them with an AI-first core, empower the business with agile digital at scale and drive continuous improvement with always-on learning through the transfer of digital skills, expertise, and ideas from our innovation ecosystem. We are deeply committed to being a well-governed, environmentally sustainable organization where diverse talent thrives in an inclusive workplace.
   

  

**All aspects of employment at Infosys are based on merit, competence and performance. We are committed to embracing diversity and creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Infosys is proud to be an equal opportunity employer**

title: Test Specialist (OSS, NOC, SOC)
description:
At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.
   

  

**Your role**
 As an
 **OSS, NOC, SOC Test Specialist** 
 at Capgemini Engineering, you will be responsible for ensuring the integrity, reliability, and security of
 **mission‑critical telecom services** 
 through rigorous end‑to‑end testing and validation. You will work closely with OSS, Network Operations Center (NOC), and Security Operations Center (SOC) teams to validate network infrastructure, systems, and security mechanisms supporting highly available telecom environments.
   

  

**In this role you will play a key role in:**
* Developing and executing comprehensive test plans for OSS, NOC, and SOC platforms, including service assurance and service fulfilment
* Validating end‑to‑end integrations between OSS/NOC/SOC tools and telecom network elements such as switches, routers, and firewalls
* Conducting functional, performance, and security testing of network management, monitoring, and incident handling systems
* Supporting disaster recovery and business continuity testing, while documenting results and recommending improvements to reliability and security


**Your profile**
* Strong understanding of OSS, NOC, and SOC functions within telecom environments
* 8-12 years of experience with network management systems (NMS), monitoring, and incident management tools
* Expertise in testing telecom protocols (e.g. SS7, SIP, MPLS, LTE, 5G) and security mechanisms
* Excellent documentation, reporting, and communication skills, with strong attention to detail


*(Experience with test automation, scripting, and certifications such as CCNA/CCNP, ITIL, CISSP, or ISO 27001 are considered advantageous.)*
**What we believe you will enjoy about working here**
* We recognize the significance of flexible work arrangements to provide support. Be it remote work, or flexible work hours, you will get an environment to maintain healthy work life balance.
* At the heart of our mission is your career growth. Our array of career growth programs and diverse professions are crafted to support you in exploring a world of opportunities.
* We support your personal development and offer an education library with more than 250 000 (!) courses and educations and certifications.


**Application**
**This role requires Swedish citizenship and is subject to security classification, meaning that a security screening will be carried out in accordance with Swedish legislation.**
 As part of our recruitment process, identity verification will be conducted through inspection of your ID card, and background checks may be carried out as required.
   

  

**About Capgemini**
 Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology, and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion. Make it real | www.capgemini.com

title: Staff Engineering Operations Manager
description:
We're not here to add to the noise. We're here to cut through it- with AI that actually works for marketers.
   

  

 From AI-powered content creation to world-class CMS and the industry's most trusted experimentation platform, Optimizely is the tool modern marketers actually want to use. AI-Ready. Set. Go.
   

  

 10,000+ brands including H&M, PayPal, and Zoom already get it. So do Gartner, Forrester, and IDC, who consistently recognize us as leaders in MarTech.
   

  

 But here's the thing about building great products: it takes great people. Our 1,600+ Optimizers across 12 global offices are curious, collaborative, and refreshingly human. We don't do corporate speak. We do real conversations, big ideas, and genuinely care for the work we make together.
   

  

 If you want to be part of a team that's shaping the future of marketing technology — and actually enjoys doing it — you're in the right place.
   

  

 Find us on Instagram: @optimizely
   

  

**Introduction**
 Optimizely is expanding its global operational capability and is now looking for a Situation Manager / Incident Commander to strengthen our Incident response function. In this role, you will lead real-time command of high-severity incidents across Optimizely’s DXP platform—including CMS, Commerce, PaaS, and cloud hosting in Azure and GCP.
   

  

 This is a high-impact operational leadership role where you coordinate cross-functional teams, maintain situational awareness, and drive rapid restoration of service for customers across the globe.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Act as the Incident Commander for high-severity incidents, ensuring fast, structured, and coordinated response.
* Maintain full situational awareness and manage the incident timeline, scope, communications, and decision-making.
* Lead Engineering, SRE, Support, and Customer Success teams through the incident lifecycle.
* Own clear communication to internal stakeholders, including executives, product teams, and customer-facing groups.
* Provide customer-facing status updates during Major Incidents and ensure external communication standards are met.
* Run structured incident bridges, drive focus, and ensure that actions, responsibilities, and follow-ups are clear.
* Ensure accurate incident documentation and support the delivery of Incident Reports, RFO/RCA, and executive summaries.
* Drive continuous improvement of Incident processes, including detection, escalation rules, and communication workflows.
* Contribute to the development of playbooks, runbooks, and automation to reduce MTTR and improve reliability.
* Be part of the global on-call rotation to support 24/7 coverage with a strong focus on EMEA hours.


**Knowledge And Experience**
* Demonstrated experience as an Incident Commander, Situation Manager, or Incident Lead in SaaS, PaaS, or hosting operations.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams under pressure and make structured, high-quality decisions quickly.
* Deep understanding of operational frameworks such as ITIL Incident Management.
* Strong communication skills, clear, assertive, and calm, capable of handling both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience coordinating incidents involving distributed, cloud-based systems (Azure and/or GCP is a plus).
* Strong situational awareness, ability to prioritize signal over noise, and maintain control of high-pressure calls.
* Experience with customer communication during critical events.
* Fluent in English and Swedish.
* Background in Engineering, SRE, or Technical Operations.
* Experience with multi-cloud environments or large-scale global SaaS platforms.
* Experience with Application Insights, Datadog, or similar observability tools.


**Education**
 Bachelor’s Degree (Computer Science or engineering preferred) or equivalent work experience
   

  

**Competencies**
 Optimizely is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Optimizely is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

title: Director of Engineering - Content Platform (Catalog)
description:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.
   

  

 This position sits at the heart of Spotify’s Content Platform, responsible for the systems that define, structure, and govern content across the platform. Our mission is to provide a trusted, consistent source of truth so content can be reliably managed and reused across every Spotify experience. We build and operate the core systems and workflows that ensure content is accurate, complete, and available, from APIs and lifecycle orchestration through to content quality and integrity.
   

  

 As Spotify’s content ecosystem continues to grow in scale and complexity across new formats, use cases, and regulatory environments, this domain plays a critical role in helping us scale intentionally while maintaining the trust and quality our users and creators expect.
   

  

 We’re seeking a Director of Engineering to lead this domain, shaping its technical direction, developing teams, and evolving the systems that underpin Spotify’s global content platform.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Lead and develop multiple engineering teams through engineering managers, supporting their growth and impact.
* Own and drive the technical strategy for a critical platform domain, aligning it with broader company and platform goals.
* Enable teams across Spotify to build product experiences efficiently by improving the underlying catalog systems.
* Guide the evolution and modernization of complex legacy systems into scalable, reliable architecture.
* Partner closely with product and cross-functional leaders to align priorities and drive execution.
* Improve system reliability and reduce operational friction in workflows that directly impact content availability.
* Identify and apply opportunities for automation and AI to improve data quality and engineering productivity.
* Build an inclusive engineering culture where teams continuously improve how they work and deliver.
* Develop and execute a long-term roadmap that balances immediate priorities with strategic investments.


 Who You Are
   

  

* You have experience leading engineering organizations through other leaders and scaling teams effectively.
* You have worked on complex, data-intensive systems where accuracy, consistency, and reliability at scale are critical.
* You bring strong system design and architectural decision-making experience in distributed systems.
* You are comfortable navigating ambiguity and making thoughtful trade-offs in high-impact environments.
* You have experience evolving legacy systems and guiding long-term platform transformations.
* You influence effectively across engineering, product, and business stakeholders.
* You have experience leading distributed teams and creating alignment across locations.
* You communicate clearly and can explain complex technical topics to a range of audiences.
* You are curious about how AI and automation can improve systems and workflows and apply that thinking pragmatically.
* You care about building inclusive, collaborative environments where teams can grow and do their best work.


 Where You'll Be
   

  

* This role is based in Stockholm or London
* We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.


 The United States base range for this position is $281,196 - $401,709 plus equity. The benefits available for this position include health insurance, six month paid parental leave, 401(k) retirement plan, monthly meal allowance, 23 paid days off, 13 paid flexible holidays, paid sick leave. These ranges may be modified in the future.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. Find our AI notice here: https://lifeatspotify.com/ai-notice
   

  

 Today, we are the world’s most popular audio streaming subscription service.

Rollen är central för att säkerställa god regelefterlevnad och bidrar till en trygg och robust digital miljö. * God analytisk förmåga samt förmåga att förmedla och kommunicera till verksamhet, beslutsfattare och olika intressenter på ett enkelt och pedagogiskt sätt.


 Som person har du hög integritet, stor framåtanda och förmåga att lyssna och förstå din omgivning. Du trivs med att arbeta både självständigt och i samarbete med andra och är trygg i kommunikationen på både svenska och engelska.

 Rekryterande chef: Hanna.Bagner@lansforsakringar.se
   

  

 Facklig representant Forena: Susanne.Hirsch2@lansforsakringar.se

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**Om Företaget** 




  





  





 Kindly note: Swedish speaking resource required from Stockholm only.
 



  





  





**Om Rollen** 




  





  





 Data Engineer - Medior. As Company owns both local and regional grids, we at DK-CI make two types of forecasts, one for local grids and one for regional grids. The power forecasts describe how much additional power is required in our electricity grid. For example, in areas such as "Housing", "Electrification of transport" and "Industry and business premises". Our forecasts are used by many in our business, including to dimension our networks, as a basis for the network development plan, as a basis for investments and reinvestments, and as a basis for dialogue with customers. As a Data Analyst/Analytics Engineer, you are part of the "Impact Forecasting" product team. Over the past few years, the team has made a major journey in how we work, from Excel to a data-driven and automated workflow where python scripting is central.
 



  





  





**Ansvarsområden** 




  





  




* Forecast work automation: Youll automate parts of the forecast work that were previously done manually, using Python code in a Databricks environment.
* Methodology development: You investigate and explore possible improvements or changes to methodology by analyzing customer data and time series data. This includes both well-defined analyses and more exploratory work, as well as collaboration with people who have other skills.
* Power BI reporting: You build new or enhance existing Power BI reports. This includes data modeling, improving existing functionality, adding new functionality, and implementing calculations.
* Updating power forecasts: You update power forecasts for specific areas. This can involve communication with municipalities and other local grid customers, checking and processing input data, generating quantitative and qualitative insights based on the results, and preparing and presenting material to stakeholders.
* Data analysis and quality assurance: Examine the availability of relevant data, collect and compile data from various sources, and ensure data quality and reliability.



  





  





**Kvalifikationer** 




  





  




* A few years of experience analyzing big data, especially customer data and time series, manipulating, data modeling, and reporting results to stakeholders.
* A few years of experience in building efficient and clear code using Python or similar programming languages.
* Previous experience from the electricity network industry or other relevant experience from the energy industry.
* Work experience with visualization software such as Power BI.
* Good knowledge of conveying messages.



  





  





**Obligatoriska Färdigheter** 




  





  




* We consider it an advantage if you also have:
* Previous experience of insight work and/or forecasting.
* Experience of working agile in SCRUM teams or equivalent knowledge.
* Experience working with AI/ML.
* Experience working with SQL or equivalent.
* It is also important that you have strong analytical skills and a high level of problem-solving skills.



  





  





**Betalningsintervall och kompensationspaket** 




  





  





 10 Years Above Data Engineer - Medior.
 



  





  





**Jämlikhetsuttalande**

**Om tjänsten**
 Vi söker en noggrann och ansvarstagande person till rollen som rotationstekniker.
   

  

 I denna roll arbetar du som ett flexibelt stöd till vår produktions samtliga avdelningar och hjälper till där behovet är som störst. Du är en praktisk problemlösare som trivs med varierande arbetsuppgifter och kan snabbt ställa om mellan olika moment.

**Exempel på arbetsuppgifter**
