title: Software Engineer (Backend)
description:
**About The Role**
 Are you passionate about building scalable solutions and working with the latest technologies? At Strawberry, we are looking for a highly skilled Software Engineer to join our forward-thinking team.
   

  

 In this role, you won't just be writing code, you will be an integral part of shaping our architecture. We are looking for a systems thinker who can zoom out to understand the overall solution and business impact, and then zoom in to deliver clean, efficient, and robust microservices and serverless implementations. If you are excited by the intersection of modern Java, cloud-native architecture, and the transformative potential of Generative AI, we want to meet you.
   

  

 What You’ll Do
   

  

* Design & Build: Develop high-performing, scalable, and secure server based and serverless applications using Java 21+ and Spring Boot.
* Systems Thinking: Collaborate with product managers and architects to understand the "big picture" and ensure your technical solutions align with broader business goals.
* Cloud & DevOps: Deploy and manage applications in AWS, actively contributing to and optimizing our CI/CD pipelines for seamless delivery.
* Champion Quality: Write testable code utilizing Test-Driven Development (TDD) and Behavior Driven Development (BDD) principles to maintain our high standards of reliability.
* Innovate with AI: Leverage Generative AI tools and concepts to optimize workflows, enhance product features, and drive innovation within the team.
* Solve Complex Problems: Tackle intricate technical challenges with a logical, analytical, and creative mindset.


**What You Bring (Requirements)**
 Core Development Skills:
   

  

* Proven experience as a Software Engineer or similar role in an Agile environment.
* Solid understanding of object-oriented programming, data structures, and algorithms.
* Familiarity with version control (Git), RESTful API design, and database management (SQL/NoSQL).
* Exceptional problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to debugging and troubleshooting.


**Specific Tech Stack & Expertise**
* Java 21+: Deep, hands-on experience with modern Java features and ecosystem. Experience in working with reactive programming paradigm is definitely an added advantage.
* Spring Boot: Strong proficiency in building robust applications and APIs.
* Microservices: Experience designing, building, and maintaining distributed microservice architectures.
* AWS Cloud: Practical experience with AWS services (e.g., EC2, Lambda, S3, ECS, DynamoDB, IAM, CF, Bedrock etc).
* CI/CD: Experience building and maintaining automated deployment pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions etc).
* TDD: A strong commitment to Test-Driven Development and writing comprehensive unit and integration tests.
* Generative AI: Familiarity with integrating LLMs, prompting techniques, or using GenAI tools to accelerate development.


 Why Join Us?
   

  

* Real Impact & Empowerment: Play a central role in a dynamic digital transformation within a flat organization built on trust, autonomy, and room to make a real difference.
* Growth & Community: Continuous professional development opportunities to advance your career , combined with a vibrant, social, and inclusive team environment.
* Fantastic Perks: Excellent employee discounts, including steep staff, friends, and family rates at our hotels.
* Flexible Work Model: A hybrid working structure featuring three days of in-person collaboration at our Stockholm or Oslo HQ, giving you the best of both worlds.


 Details
   

  

 You will report to the Engineering manager of Omni (Business rule platform). For this position, your base will be in Stockholm. Strawberry applies a 3-day office presence policy. While there is some flexibility for hybrid solutions, this role requires a strong, consistent physical presence in Stockholm. Selection is ongoing and the position may be filled before the closing date, so please apply as soon as possible.
   

  

 We are Strawberry. With over 245 hotels, 120 restaurants, 20 spas and more, we create thousands of experiences every day. With urban Comfort Hotel®, warm Quality Hotel™, stylish Clarion Hotel® and cosy Home Hotel and more than 40 unique independent hotels, our guests can pick and choose. Our team of 20,000 passionate individuals from more than 120 countries is what makes us grow! Strawberry is built on our core values: energy, courage and enthusiasm.

title: Atlassian Solution Architect
description:
**Team: Internal IT - Location: Stockholm/Malmö/Gothenburg**
 Pacera unifies financial close, consolidation and FP&A. With AARO, Aico and Mercur, finance teams combine trusted data with AI-driven insights to enable robust, scalable and intelligent processes for the Office of the CFO.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for an experienced
 **Atlassian Solution Architect & Platform Owner** 
 to lead the design, governance, and continuous improvement of our Atlassian platform. In this strategic and hands-on role, you will own the architecture, health, and evolution of Jira, Confluence, Jira Service Management, plugins, AI capabilities, and related integrations, ensuring they support business growth, operational excellence, security, and compliance.
   

  

 You will serve as both the technical authority and platform owner, working closely with IT, development teams, service management, and business stakeholders to deliver a scalable and future-proof Atlassian environment.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
*Solution Architecture*
* Design and maintain enterprise-scale solutions across Jira, Confluence, and Jira Service Management.
* Maintain and define platform architecture, data structures, workflows, and governance models.
* Develop and maintain integrations with platforms such as GitHub, Netsuite, Hubspot, EntraID, Microsoft 365, and other business-critical systems.
* Drive automation, workflow optimisation, and process standardisation across departments.
* Ensure platform scalability, performance, and alignment with organisational objectives.
* Ensure a financially healthy and sustainable Atlassian environment.


*Technical System Ownership*
* Own the overall health, availability, performance, and security of the Atlassian platform.
* Manage vendor relationships, licensing, contract renewals, and cost optimisation.
* Evaluate and govern Marketplace applications and third-party integrations.
* Establish lifecycle management, data retention, and platform governance standards.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory and security requirements, including GDPR and corporate security policies.
* Lead change management, user adoption, training initiatives, and platform communication.
* Lead AI implementation, governance and data source maintenance for the Atlassian suite.


**What we’re looking for**
* Several years of experience administering and architecting Atlassian environments.
* Deep expertise in Jira, Confluence, and Jira Service Management.
* Proven experience delivering enterprise-scale Atlassian implementations and transformations.
* Strong understanding of IT Service Management processes and best practices.
* Experience designing integrations using APIs and automation frameworks.
* Solid knowledge of security, identity management, compliance, and governance principles.
* Experience managing stakeholders across technical and business functions.
* Strategic thinker with strong analytical skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
* Able to balance business requirements with technical and financial considerations.
* Proactive, structured, and passionate about driving continuous improvement.
* Comfortable working both strategically and operationally


*Preferred Qualifications*
* Atlassian certifications such as Atlassian Certified Expert, ACP, or similar.
* Knowledge of DevOps toolchains and agile delivery practices.
* Familiarity with enterprise architecture and AI capabilities within the Atlassian products.


**About Pacera**
 Pacera is a financial operations software company supporting the Office of the CFO across planning, financial close, consolidation and reporting. With a unified platform consisting of three specialised products, Aico by Pacera, AARO by Pacera and Mercur by Pacera, we help finance teams run critical finance operations with accuracy, control and confidence.
   

  

**Aico** 
 – automates and streamlines financial close processes
   

  

**Mercur** 
 – powers FP&A, budgeting, forecasting, business intelligence and financial analytics
   

  

**AARO** 
 – provides consolidation and group reporting solutions
   

  

 Each product has a strong existing customer base with double-digit year-on-year growth. Together, the unified end-to-end SaaS platform is empowering finance and executive leaders with automation, compliance and actionable insights – enabling faster decision-making, enhanced governance, and visibility.
   

  

 The company is headquartered in Stockholm, with offices in Sweden, Finland, Latvia and the UK.
   

  

 Backed by
 **Accel-KKR** 
 , a global technology-focused investment firm, the group has ambitious growth plans driven by both organic expansion and acquisitions. We are now strengthening our operations by investing in key roles that support our platform and future scalability.
   

  

**Apply now**

title: Cloud Compliance Engineer ﻿
description:
*Passionate about making ideas a reality? Join our welcoming world of tech and let your ideas soar.*

### **Your role**


As a **Cloud Compliance Engineer for enabling platforms at Common Tech** you will help build secure, resilient, and compliant cloud platforms by embedding security and compliance into development and operational processes. Working closely with architects, developers, platform engineers, and security teams, you will drive Compliance as Code, Policy as Code, and automated control validation to ensure secure-by-default cloud environments.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Translate regulatory and security requirements into reusable technical controls and cloud guardrails.
* Develop and maintain Compliance as Code and Policy as Code solutions.
* Automate compliance validation, evidence collection, monitoring, and reporting.
* Integrate continuous compliance into CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code workflows.
* Support compliance with standards such as NIST, ISO 27001 and NATO requirements.
* Contribute to risk assessments, audit readiness, and continuous authorization practices.

### **Your Profile**


You are a proactive and analytical engineer who believes compliance should be automated and embedded into platforms, enabling teams to deliver secure and compliant solutions by design.

**You also have:**

* A relevant academic degree or equivalent experience in IT security, cloud engineering, software or a related field.
* Proven experience securing AWS and/or Azure environments.
* Hands-on experience with Compliance as Code, Policy as Code, and Infrastructure as Code.
* Strong understanding of NIST, CSA CCM, ISO 27001, CIS Controls, and related security frameworks.
* Experience with tools such as Terraform, Bicep, CloudFormation, Azure Policy, AWS Config, OPA, Sentinel, or similar.
* Familiarity with DevSecOps and security integration within CI/CD pipelines.
* Knowledge of cloud governance, secure landing zones, and zero-trust principles.
* Experience in regulated or mission-critical environments is an advantage.
* Strong communication skills in both Swedish and English.

*This position requires that you pass a security vetting based on the current regulations around/of security protection. For positions requiring security clearance additional obligations on citizenship may apply.*

### **What you will be part of**


Explore a wealth of possibilities. Take on challenges, create smart inventions, and grow beyond. This is a place for curious minds, brave pioneers, and everyone in between. Together, we achieve the extraordinary, each bringing our unique perspectives. Your part matters.


Saab is a leading defense and security company with an enduring purpose, to help nations keep their people and society safe. Empowered by its 28,000 talented people, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world.

description:
Vill du vara med och skapa säkra och hållbara byggnader genom teknik i framkant? Som Serviceingenjör på Siemens Smart Infrastructure blir du en nyckelperson i vårt arbete med att hjälpa kunder att lyfta sin brandsäkerhet till nästa nivå. Genom att kombinera din tekniska expertis med digitala lösningar blir du kundens strategiska samarbetspartner och "trusted advisor".

**Om rollen** I den här rollen arbetar du nära våra kunder för att föreslå förbättringar inom hållbarhet, teknik och digitalisering. Du skapar mervärde genom att lyssna på kundens behov och erbjuda tjänster som bidrar till deras utveckling. En viktig del av din vardag är att främja den digitala utvecklingen genom att använda verktyg för fjärrsupport och molntjänster.

 **I den här rollen får du möjlighet att göra verklig skillnad genom att:**  

* Utveckla kunders anläggningar genom hållbarhetsfrämjande insatser och digitalisering.
* Förklara och demonstrera hur fjärranslutning och molntjänster (t.ex. cRSP och DCC Cloud) skapar säkra och effektiva lösningar som sparar tid och resurser.
* Agera säljstöd för digitala tjänster och identifiera förbättringsförslag som minskar risker och effektiviserar driften.
* Samarbeta med centrala expertfunktioner och partners för att optimera leveransen till kund.
* Arbetsleda kollegor och partners vid utförande av sålda förbättringsförslag.
* Ansvara för planering, prioritering och materielbeställningar i dina uppdrag.
* Aktivt bidra till att Siemens är kundens mest pålitliga rådgivare inom brandsäkerhet.

 **Vi tror att du**  

* Har en djup förståelse för brandsäkerhetssystem och deras potential i en hållbar byggnad.
* Har ett affärsmässigt tänkande och förstår hur din insats påverkar det ekonomiska resultatet.
* Besitter ett utmärkt kundbemötande med förmåga att presentera lösningar.
* Har goda IT- och datakunskaper samt förståelse för systemsamband.
* Är självständig i att identifiera, analysera och lösa tekniska problem.
* Känner till branschspecifika lagkrav, regelverk och entreprenadjuridik.
* Kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska samt innehar B-körkort.

 **Du vill fortsätta utveckla din kompetens inom exempelvis:**  

* Systematiskt brandskyddsarbete (SBA) och brandskyddskoordination.
* Molnbaserade lösningar och digitala tjänster (Energy as a Service, cRSP).
* Strategisk kundutveckling och rådgivande försäljning.

 **Därför ska du välja oss** Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta i en miljö med spännande utmaningar där vi tillsammans driver utvecklingen framåt. Vi erbjuder:  

* + **Flexibla arbetsformer:** Möjlighet till hybridarbete för en bra balans i livet.

title: Administratör 75 %
description:
Är du en noggrann och flexibel person med administrativ förmåga som gillar att arbeta stödjande och serviceinriktat?
  
Svenska kyrkan i Ljungby utgör ett pastorat med åtta församlingar i både stad och levande landsbygd. Vi är ca 50 medarbetare som jobbar med allt från gudstjänster, kristen undervisning och socialt arbete (diakoni) till kyrkogårdsskötsel. Dessutom har vi många förtroendevalda och frivilliga medarbetare. Du kommer att arbeta med kollegor på vår expedition som arbetar med att ge god service till hela pastoratet.
  
ANSVARSOMRÅDEN
  
Tjänsten är omväxlande med inriktning på lokalt användarstöd för IT-system, datorer, mobiltelefoner i kombination med administrativt arbete. Användarstödet innebär att hjälpa våra medarbetare med installationer, uppdateringar och felsökningar av datorer och mobiltelefoner, ibland även utbilda i våra administrativa system.
  
Du kommer även att vara en del i produktionen av grafiskt material som till exempel annonser, affischer samt arbete med våra social medier. I det löpande administrativa arbetet kan till exempel posthantering, arkiv, diariehantering och telefonservice/reception förekomma.
  
VI SÖKER DIG SOM
  
har erfarenhet av IT och administrativa system samt praktisk hantering av datorer och mobiltelefoner
  
har erfarenhet av administrativt arbete
  
har god förmåga att uttrycka dig på svenska i både tal och skrift
  
har kunskaper i Adobe Creative Cloud, särskilt InDesign och Photoshop och erfarenhet av grafisk produktion
  
har goda kunskaper i Microsoft 365, erfarenhet av Svenska kyrkans system är meriterande
  
har kunskap om Svenska kyrkans organisation och verksamhet
  
  

**SOM PERSON ÄR DU:**  

serviceinriktad och har ett gott bemötande
  
ansvarstagande och har god samarbetsförmåga
  
självständig och lösningsorienterad
  
noggrann och kan strukturera och prioritera bland olika arbetsuppgifter
  
lyhörd inför verksamhetens behov
  
  

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet och förutsätter att du är medlem i Svenska kyrkan och respekterar och delar dess värderingar.
  
Körkort och tillgång till egen bil.
  
  

UPPLYSNINGAR OM TJÄNSTEN
  
Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning, 75 %. Vi tillämpar provanställning.
  
Tillträde enligt överenskommelse.
  
  

ANSÖKAN
  
Välkommen med din ansökan med CV och personligt brev och referenser till ljungby.pastorat@svenskakyrkan.se
  
Vi tillämpar löpande rekrytering så skicka in din ansökan så snart som möjligt, dock senast den 18 september.

title: Cloud & Modern Workplace Engineer
description:
Vi på Linden-IT söker nu en Cloud & Modern Workplace Engineer till ett växande IT-bolag i Stockholm. Det här är en bred och tekniskt varierad roll för dig som vill arbeta med moderna molnmiljöer, Microsoft 365, endpoint management, nätverk och IT-säkerhet – och som trivs med att arbeta med flera olika kundmiljöer.

  

Du blir en viktig del av ett kompetent Operationsteam där du får vara med och designa, implementera och förvalta moderna IT-lösningar. Rollen passar dig som gillar att kombinera strategiskt tänkande och arkitektur med praktiskt, hands-on arbete.

**Om bolaget**
--------------


Vår kund är ett växande IT-bolag som levererar moderna IT-tjänster till företag som vill ha teknik som fungerar och en personlig service. De arbetar nära sina kunder och tar ett helhetsansvar för deras IT-miljöer, med fokus på stabilitet, säkerhet och långsiktiga lösningar.

  

Bolaget har en varm, familjär och entreprenöriell kultur där samarbete, kompetensdelning och personlig utveckling värderas högt. Här får du möjlighet att påverka teknikval, arbetssätt och lösningar samtidigt som du arbetar tillsammans med kompetenta kollegor.

**Om rollen**
-------------


Som Cloud & Modern Workplace Engineer arbetar du brett med Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Intune, Autopilot, nätverk och IT-säkerhet. Rollen kombinerar drift, utveckling och arkitektur, där du får arbeta både hands-on och som teknisk specialist i projekt och kunddialoger.

**Arbetsuppgifter**
-------------------

* Drift, utveckling, optimering och säkerhet i Microsoft Azure
* Administration och förvaltning av Microsoft 365, inklusive Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint och OneDrive
* Endpoint Management med Microsoft Intune och Autopilot
* Design och dokumentation av moln-, nätverks- och hybridlösningar
* Drift, patchning och säkerhet av nätverksmiljöer och nätverksutrustning
* Arbete med brandväggar, LAN/WAN/WLAN och nätverkssäkerhet
* Övervakning, säkerhetsarbete och hantering av IT-säkerhetsincidenter
* Arbete med Zero Trust och compliance, bland annat GDPR och ISO
* Backup, disaster recovery och test av återställningsplaner
* Kostnadsoptimering och kapacitetsplanering i Azure
* Leda mindre tekniska projekt och bidra som specialist i större projekt
* Vara tekniskt stöd till servicedesk och stötta vid behov under perioder med hög belastning

**Vem är du?**
--------------


Vi söker dig som är tekniskt nyfiken, lösningsorienterad och trivs med en bred roll där du får kombinera drift, utveckling och arkitektur. Du tycker om att förstå helheten men är samtidigt bekväm med att arbeta praktiskt och hands-on.

  

Du är strukturerad och självgående, men uppskattar också att arbeta tillsammans med kompetenta kollegor och dela med dig av din kunskap. Du har ett tydligt kundfokus och kan kommunicera tekniska frågor på ett enkelt och pedagogiskt sätt.

### **Krav:**

* Minst 3 års erfarenhet av arbete i Microsoft-miljöer
* God praktisk erfarenhet av Microsoft Azure och Microsoft 365
* Erfarenhet av Microsoft Intune och Autopilot
* God förståelse för nätverk, virtualisering och IT-säkerhet
* Erfarenhet av att designa och dokumentera tekniska lösningar
* Förmåga att arbeta självständigt och strukturerat i flera kundmiljöer
* God kommunikativ förmåga på svenska och engelska
* B-körkort

### **Meriterande:**

* Certifieringar som AZ-104, MS-102, MD-102 eller MS-900
* Erfarenhet från MSP, IT-partner eller konsultbolag
* Hands-on erfarenhet av Fortinet, Clavister, HPE, Aruba, Ruckus eller Unify
* Erfarenhet av migrerings- och moderniseringsprojekt
* Erfarenhet av Zero Trust, GDPR eller ISO-relaterat säkerhetsarbete
* Erfarenhet av backup- och disaster recovery-lösningar

**Övrigt:**
-----------

* **Placering:** Solna
* **Start:** Så snart som möjligt, med hänsyn till uppsägningstid

**Ansökan**
-----------


Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, så skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt.

title: Junior Grafisk designer
description:
Vill du vara med och skapa det visuella uttrycket för ett varumärke där enkelhet, funktion och estetik möts?


GRANIT söker nu en Junior Grafisk Designer som vill bli en del av vårt kreativa team och vara med och utveckla vår visuella kommunikation från idé till färdig produktion.

**Om Granit**


Granit skapar inspirerande produkter och miljöer för vardagslivet. Med nordisk design, genomtänkta val och kvalitet som håller vill vi göra det enkelt att skapa både funktion och känsla, hemma, på jobbet och i livet. Hos oss möts form och funktion i ett noga utvalt sortiment som är lätt att kombinera, prissatt med omtanke och gjort för att användas länge.


Granit har idag medarbetare i fyra länder som varje dag arbetar för att göra vardagen lite enklare, finare och mer inspirerande. Sedan 2008 är vi en del av Bergendahlskoncernen, en expansiv och stark dagligvaru- och detaljhandelskoncern med butiker i flera länder.

**Välkommen till oss på Granit!**


Hos Granit sätter vi alltid kunden först. Vi drivs av att förstå behov, skapa värde och leverera produkter som håller över tid. I en inkluderande och ansvarstagande kultur jobbar vi tillsammans mot tydliga mål – med fokus på både kundupplevelse och resultat.


Vi erbjuder en trygg arbetsmiljö med goda utvecklingsmöjligheter, marknadsmässiga villkor, personalrabatt, friskvårdsbidrag och kollektivavtal.

**Om rollen**


Som Junior Grafisk Designer hos GRANIT får du en varierad och kreativ roll där du arbetar med vårt visuella uttryck i flera olika kanaler och format. Du kommer att vara med och ta fram material för bland annat kampanjer, sociala medier, digitala kanaler, butikskommunikation, nyhetsbrev och print.


Du arbetar nära vårt kreativa team och får möjlighet att både bidra med egna idéer och utvecklas genom att arbeta tillsammans med erfarna kollegor.


Vi tror att du trivs i en miljö där form, funktion och detaljer är viktiga och där det visuella ska kännas lika genomtänkt som det är inspirerande.


Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter

* Ta fram grafiskt material för digitala och fysiska kanaler
* Anpassa och vidareutveckla kampanjmaterial och visuella koncept
* Skapa innehåll för sociala medier, webb och nyhetsbrev
* Producera material för butik och print bla. i vårt skyltsystem Shoppa
* Säkerställa att GRANITs visuella identitet är konsekvent i alla touchpoints
* Samarbeta med kreatörer, marknad och andra delar av organisationen
* Bidra med idéer och perspektiv i det kreativa arbetet

**Vem är du?**


Vi söker dig som är i början av din karriär och har ett stort intresse för grafisk design, varumärken och visuell kommunikation. Du är nyfiken, noggrann och prestigelös och tycker om att både tänka kreativt och få saker gjorda.


Vi ser gärna att du har:

* Relevant utbildning inom grafisk design, visuell kommunikation eller motsvarande
* Goda kunskaper i Figma och Adobe Creative Cloud, framför allt InDesign, Photoshop, After Effects och Illustrator
* Ett öga för typografi, färg, komposition och detaljer
* Förmåga att arbeta utifrån en visuell identitet och samtidigt bidra med egna idéer
* Gärna erfarenhet av digital design och sociala medier
* En portfolio som visar ditt visuella tänkande och din kreativa bredd


Som person är du engagerad, lösningsorienterad och nyfiken. Du gillar att samarbeta men är också trygg i att driva dina egna uppgifter framåt.

**Vi erbjuder**


Hos GRANIT får du möjlighet att utvecklas i ett kreativt och varumärkesdrivet företag med höga ambitioner. Du blir en del av ett team där idéer, kvalitet och samarbete står i centrum.


Här får du möjlighet att arbeta med ett starkt visuellt koncept och vara med och påverka hur GRANIT upplevs i allt från den lilla detaljen till den stora kampanjen.

**Ta nästa steg tillsammans med oss**


Låter det här som något för dig? Skicka in CV, portfolio samt personligt brev, vi arbetar löpande med urval och intervjuer.

  

För mer information om tjänsten, kontakta **Head of Brand & Creative, Sofia Leveson** sofia.leveson@granit.com

**Välkommen med din ansökan!**

title: NetSuite Systems Engineer
description:
**Location**  

As a Financial Systems Engineer, you will be part of Business Systems Engineering, a group of several teams that builds and runs the systems the company operates on. This role is based remotely in the United States (Eastern time zone), the UK, or Ireland.


**Who We Are**  

DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers are operating in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production.



Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multi-cloud problems and drive efficiency.



With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure and Ingram Micro, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide.


**The Opportunity**  

We are modernizing how we run our financial systems and bringing this work in-house, and we're looking for a Financial Systems Engineer to own it. You will own our financial systems - NetSuite today, with FloQast and Ramp coming online - as an engineer, not just an administrator.



What sets this role apart is mindset. You are the kind of person who is averse to doing the same manual task twice and instinctively looks for ways to automate it away. You will own the configuration and business logic of the financial systems, keeping each one doing what it does best, and partner with our internal engineering team on cross-system integration rather than wiring it together by hand.



This is a high-ownership role serving Finance and Accounting directly. You will be their dedicated systems partner - someone who knows the platforms deeply, is invested in making them better, and treats reducing manual, error-prone work as the core of the job rather than something to do on the side. Reporting to the Manager of Enterprise Systems, you will have real room to shape how finance operations run as the company scales


**Responsibilities**


* Own and administer our core financial systems - NetSuite today, with FloQast and Ramp coming online - including configuration, business logic, and day-to-day system health.
* Identify manual, recurring, or error-prone finance operations (month-end close, reconciliations, reporting, procure-to-pay) and reduce or remove them through automation, choosing the simplest effective approach and partnering with engineering for heavier builds.
* Serve as the business-logic and data expert for the finance domain, partnering with engineering to define and maintain the rules and canonical definitions the systems rely on.
* Build cross-system integrations on a central, version-controlled, observable integration platform in partnership with engineering, rather than as one-off scripts buried inside individual tools.
* Act as the dedicated systems partner to Finance and Accounting: translate their needs into system capability, own those working relationships, and serve as the technical owner for financial-vendor onboarding, configuration, and administration.
* Use modern AI tooling to draft automations and accelerate routine system work, amplifying your output rather than adding manual effort.


**Qualifications**


* 3-6 years administering a financial or ERP system, with hands-on NetSuite administration required, including:
* + configuration, customization, user access, roles, permissions, and workflows;
	+ core modules such as General Ledger, Advanced Revenue Management, Accounts, and subsidiary / multi-location structures;
	+ designing and implementing custom records, fields, and automations;
	+ building SuiteFlow automations in response to changing business needs;
	+ managing the NetSuite integration ecosystem.
* A working understanding of core finance and accounting processes: month-end close, reconciliation, accounts payable / procure-to-pay, and revenue.
* A strong drive to eliminate repetitive manual work, with a demonstrated track record of automating it (e.g. scripting, saved searches, workflow automation, or low-code/iPaaS tools).
* Sound judgment about where logic belongs - what should be system configuration, what should be a cross-system integration, and which system is the source of truth for a given piece of data.
* Comfort with at least one of SuiteScript, SQL, general scripting, or API-based automation, and the ability to read and reason about integrations even when engineering builds them.
* Strong collaboration and communication across both finance and engineering teams, with the ability to translate between them.
* Fluent English; knowledge of any other language is an advantage.


**Bonus Points:**


* FloQast and/or Ramp administration experience.
* Experience working against a central integration platform or in an event-driven environment.
* Comfort using AI coding and automation tools in day-to-day work.
* Depth in SuiteScript (1.0 / 2.0), RESTlets, or NetSuite web services.


**Are you a Do'er?**  

Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference.



We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally.


What does being a Do'er mean? We're all about being entrepreneurial, pursuing knowledge, and having fun! Click here to learn more about our core values.



Sounds too good to be true? Check out our Glassdoor Page.



We thought so too, but we're here and happy we hit that 'apply' button.



Full-time employee benefits include:

* Home Office Allowance
* Professional Development Stipend
* Peer Recognition Program


**Many Do'ers, One Team**  

DoiT unites as *Many Do'ers, One Team*, where diversity is more than a goal—it's our strength. We actively cultivate an inclusive, equitable workplace, recognizing that each unique perspective enhances our innovation. By celebrating differences, we create an environment where every individual feels valued, contributing to our collective success.

title: Financial Controller till kund i Ljungby!
description:
Är du en erfaren Financial Controller som trivs nära verksamheten och vill kombinera operativt ekonomiarbete med analys, rapportering och verksamhetsstöd? Nu söker vi dig som vill kliva in i ett spännande konsultuppdrag hos en större och välkänd aktör inom logistik.
  
I rollen blir du en del av ett centralt finansteam och får en viktig position i att stötta den operativa verksamheten genom effektiva finansiella processer, analys och uppföljning.
  
  

**Praktiska detaljer:**  

**Plats:** Ljungby Start: 5 oktober 2026 ⏳ Uppdragsperiod: Till 31 december 2026, med möjlighet till förlängning Omfattning: Heltid 100 % Hybridarbete: Möjlighet till distansarbete, med fysisk närvaro minst 3 dagar i veckan
  
Om rollen
  
Som Financial Controller arbetar du nära både finansteamet och den operativa verksamheten. Du har löpande kontakt med verksamhetens logistikenheter och bidrar med såväl finansiell kompetens som analys och stöd i det dagliga arbetet.
  
Rollen passar dig som tycker om att kombinera struktur och noggrannhet med ett verksamhetsnära och lösningsorienterat arbetssätt. Du är bekväm med att ta eget ansvar, prioritera mellan olika arbetsuppgifter och snabbt sätta dig in i nya processer och system.
  
Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter
  
  

**Du kommer bland annat att:**  

* Arbeta operativt inom centrala finansprocesser såsom kundfakturering (Order to Cash), leverantörsfakturor (Purchase to Pay) och bokslut (Record to Report). • Stötta verksamheten med månadsrapportering, statistik och analys av finansiella data. • Bidra i budget- och prognosarbetet. • Säkerställa att finansiella rutiner, processer och övergripande policys efterlevs. • Samarbeta nära den operativa verksamheten och bygga förtroendefulla relationer med olika delar av organisationen.


Vi söker dig som har
  
* Cirka 5 års erfarenhet som ekonomiadministratör och/eller Controller inom logistik. • Goda kunskaper i SAP eller annat ERP-system. • Mycket goda kunskaper i Microsoft Excel och Office-paketet. • God kommunikativ förmåga på svenska och engelska, i både tal och skrift.


Det är meriterande om du har en akademisk examen inom ekonomi samt erfarenhet av Business Intelligence-verktyg såsom QlikView, Microsoft Power BI eller SAP Analytics Cloud.
  
Vem är du?
  
För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du är självgående, kommunikativ och lösningsorienterad. Du arbetar strukturerat och noggrant samtidigt som du har förmågan att behålla fokus när tempot är högt.
  
Du har ett analytiskt förhållningssätt, tar ansvar för dina leveranser och är van vid att självständigt prioritera ditt arbete. Eftersom rollen innebär många kontaktytor är det också viktigt att du uppskattar samarbete och har lätt för att skapa förtroendefulla relationer på olika nivåer i en organisation.
  
✨Låter det intressant?
  
Skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt. Urval och presentation av kandidater sker löpande, vilket innebär att uppdraget kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.
  
Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!
  
Sway Sourcing är en innovativ rekryteringspartner som specialiserar sig på att matcha rätt talang med rätt företag – snabbt och effektivt. Vårt huvudfokus ligger inom Ekonomi, Administration, HR, Marknad och IT, men vi har även den breda expertis och flexibilitet som krävs för att leverera skräddarsydda rekryteringslösningar inom alla branscher.
  
Trots att vi är en relativt ny aktör har vi redan byggt förtroende hos många av Sveriges största företag och arbetar både nationellt och internationellt. Med baser i Sverige och Spanien erbjuder vi en unik kombination av lokal expertis och global räckvidd. Vårt starka nätverk och djupa branschinsikter gör oss till en självklar partner för företag som vill ligga steget före i sin rekrytering.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer ﻿
description:
*Passionate about making ideas a reality? Join our welcoming world of tech and let your ideas soar.*

Do you want to help bridge the gap between today and the future — and play a key role in driving Saab’s digital transformation? It’s no longer only about how fast Saab’s products can fly, how deep they can dive or how far they can reach. It’s also about how fast they can adapt — always further, forever beyond. Saab is entering a new era of software transformation, where speed, intelligent use of data and systems that evolve as fast as the world changes are essential.


In this transformation, **Common Tech** and **Product Tech** are key enablers. We build the shared platforms and components and enable Saab’s product teams to move faster, innovate more freely and shorten the time from need to real‑world capability.


Together, we bridge the gap between current engineering practices and the capabilities required for Saab’s digital transformation — redefining how we build software, use data and deliver systems at speed.

### **Your role**


As a **Forward Deployed Engineer**, you'll partner with product teams across Saab to solve complex technical challenges and accelerate innovation. You will build solutions, introduce new technologies and platforms, and help teams successfully adopt modern engineering practices.


The role combines hands-on software engineering with technical leadership, enabling both technology and people to move forward. This is not a traditional developer role. It's a role for curious engineers who thrive in new environments, enjoy variety, and are motivated by creating real impact.

**What you'll do**

* Work hands-on with complex technical challenges across different product areas
* Partner with product teams to understand their needs and turn them into scalable technical solutions
* Build and improve shared platforms, tools, and components that enable reuse across Saab
* Explore and apply technologies such as AI, cloud, edge computing, and real-time systems
* Enable teams to adopt and successfully apply modern technologies, platforms, and engineering practices in real product environments
* Help establish new ways of working that increase speed, quality, and collaboration
* Turn ambiguous challenges into clear, practical solutions
* Influence technical direction and long-term platform strategy

### **Your profile**


You enjoy working where technology, innovation, and real-world impact meet. You're someone who likes understanding complex systems, exploring new possibilities, and turning ideas into practical solutions. You combine strong engineering skills with curiosity and a pragmatic mindset. While your background may be in software engineering, systems engineering, data engineering, platform engineering, or a related field, what matters most is your ability to solve complex problems, navigate ambiguity, and help others move forward.


You are comfortable taking ownership of technical challenges, collaborating with diverse stakeholders, and balancing hands-on engineering with enabling long-term success for teams and products.

**What you'll bring**


We're looking for engineers who have built a solid foundation through experience and are ready to apply it across a variety of technical challenges.


You likely have:

* Several years of experience working with software or systems engineering in complex product or technology environments
* Experience designing, building, or evolving technical solutions that are used by others
* Familiarity with modern engineering practices such as cloud technologies, CI/CD, automation, platform engineering, or distributed systems
* An interest in how AI, data, and emerging technologies can create practical value
* The ability to break down complex problems and turn uncertainty into clear direction
* Strong collaboration skills and an eagerness to learn from and share knowledge with others


It's a bonus if you have experience with:

* Cloud-native platforms and infrastructure
* AI/ML applications in real-world products
* Platform engineering and reusable building blocks
* Systems architecture and technical leadership
* Real-time, safety-critical, or highly regulated environments


We know that great engineers bring different experiences and perspectives. If this role excites you, but you don't meet every single qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Your potential, curiosity, and ability to learn are just as important as any individual technology or tool.

*This position requires that you pass a security vetting based on the current regulations around/of security protection. For positions requiring security clearance additional obligations on citizenship may apply.*

### **What you will be part of**


Explore a wealth of possibilities. Take on challenges, create smart inventions, and grow beyond. This is a place for curious minds, brave pioneers, and everyone in between. Together, we achieve the extraordinary, each bringing our unique perspectives. Your part matters.


Saab is a leading defense and security company with an enduring purpose, to help nations keep their people and society safe. Empowered by its 28,000 talented people, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world.


Saab designs, manufactures and maintains advanced systems in aeronautics, weapons, command and control, sensors and underwater systems. Saab is headquartered in Sweden. It has major operations all over the world and is part of the domestic defense capability of several nations. Read more about us here
company_description: Saab serves the global market with world-leading products, services and solutions from military defense to civil security.

title: Power Electronics Engineer
description:
**Qamcom is growing and we are looking for a talented Power Electronics Engineer with experience to join our Qamcom office in Gothenburg!**


Qamcom Research and Technology is a dynamic hub of innovation, offering specialist consulting services and product development with an emphasis on intelligent, connected systems. Our expertise spans a wide range of areas including sensors and radars, image and signal processing, embedded hardware and software, multi-modal AI analytics, wireless communication systems, application software, edge-cloud infrastructure, and functional safety.


Our team combines deep technical expertise with a collaborative mindset, allowing us to develop complete products for serial production. We take ownership of every aspect of the development chain, from initial design to final product.

**About the role:**  

We are looking for a Senior Power Electronics Engineer to join Qamcom. In this role, you will design, analyse, simulate and verify advanced power electronics solutions across a variety of applications and industries.  

You will work across the full technical scope—from power conversion and switching strategies to control circuitry, protection, filtering and thermal performance. Depending on the project, you may contribute to anything from sensor-related applications to larger and more complex power conversion systems.  

The role combines hands-on engineering with in-depth analysis and verification. You will work both independently and alongside experienced colleagues and customers throughout different stages of the development process.

**Qualifications**  

To succeed in this role, we believe that you have:

* 6 years or more professional experience in power electronics design.
* Strong experience designing and verifying power conversion solutions, including DC/DC and AC/DC converters.
* Experience in analogue circuit design for monitoring and control applications.
* Solid knowledge of power electronics topologies, switching techniques and control methods.
* Experience working with power semiconductors and associated gate-driver circuits.
* A good understanding of power losses, thermal management, protection and EMI/EMC considerations.
* Experience with circuit simulation and schematic capture tools, such as LTspice, PSpice or Cadence.
* Swedish citizenship, as required by the security requirements associated with the role.

**Qamcom Offers**  

At Qamcom, we foster a collaborative and inclusive environment where experienced professionals and specialists work together on cutting-edge system solutions. Our in-house projects span hardware, software, and algorithms for industrial and MedTech applications, allowing you to apply advanced technology in real-world product development.


We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team because we know that different perspectives drive innovation. If you’re passionate about RF design and bring relevant skills and experience, we want to hear from you. Your unique background and approach could be exactly what we need.

**Additionally, a sample of general benefits are listed below:**

* Competitive insurance and pension program
* Generous parental leave (90% of the salary)
* Wellness policy (5000 SEK/year)
* Leasing of a bicycle and option for an employee car (electric or hybrid)
* Fixed salary with annual salary reviews

title: Engineering Manager
description:
Join Telavox as an Engineering Manager
  
At Telavox, we’re looking for an Engineering Manager who is comfortable leading inside a fast-moving organisation, someone who can hold a team steady while priorities shift and knows how to introduce just enough structure to make a team faster, not slower. You’ll combine leading people with strong engineering judgement, and you’ll care as much about how reliably your team ships as about how quickly they move.
  
If you enjoy working with people, leading through change, and empowering teams to do their best work, this is your opportunity to make a real difference.
  
About the job
  
As an Engineering Manager at Telavox, you’ll lead our Telephony Team, responsible for developing people, strengthening team performance, and aligning engineering efforts with business and product goals.
  
The Telephony Team works on core telephony capabilities and collaborates closely with other engineering and product teams. You’ll help shape effective processes and ways of working, manage dependencies, and ensure clear technical contracts and interfaces between teams.
  
You’ll work closely with engineers, Product, and other stakeholders, contributing to technical discussions and architectural decisions while ensuring the team delivers scalable and sustainable solutions.
  
  

**Your day-to-day work will include:**  

* Leading, coaching, and developing the Telephony Team, supporting growth, performance, and well-being
* Establishing effective processes and ways of working, adding structure where needed and removing it where it isn’t
* Creating clarity when priorities shift and translating business needs into clear plans
* Partnering with Product on priorities, roadmaps, and outcomes; delivering a highly scalable and competitive telephony platform
* Collaborating with other Engineering Managers and teams on dependencies, technical contracts, and interfaces
* Contributing to technical and architectural decisions and ensuring long-term scalability, availability, and maintainability
* Contributing to hiring and building a strong, inclusive, and diverse engineering team in a collaborative and high-performing environment
* Helping shape the broader engineering strategy, technical direction, and culture across engineering teams


About you
  
You’re a confident engineering leader who is comfortable with ambiguity, able to create clarity, and interested in understanding the bigger picture. As the leader of the Telephony Team, you’ll work across a broad technical landscape, from core telephony to cloud, software architecture, and operations. You don’t need to be an expert in every area, but you have solid technical understanding, curiosity, and a willingness to learn.
  
You may come from a Senior or Lead Engineer background and stay close enough to technology to make sound decisions around architecture, quality, reliability, and trade-offs.
  
  

**Key skills and experience we’re looking for:**  

* Proven experience leading engineering teams as an Engineering Manager, Tech Lead, or similar
* Strong people leadership skills, including coaching, mentoring, and developing individuals
* Experience creating effective processes, ways of working, and structures that help teams perform
* Comfortable with ambiguity and able to turn changing priorities into clear direction
* Solid technical understanding and curiosity across different technologies and domains
* Experience working with production software where reliability, quality, and maintainability matter
* Ability to connect engineering decisions to product and business priorities, and challenge constructively when needed
* Passion for building a healthy, inclusive, and high-performing team culture


**Good-to-have skills:**  

* Good understanding of telephony concepts such as SIP, RTP, and related technologies
* Experience from a SaaS or B2B environment
* Familiarity with cloud architecture, event-driven systems, and DevOps practices
* Interest in using AI tooling to improve engineering ways of working


At Telavox, you’ll have the opportunity to grow as a leader, shape how we build software, and be part of a company that values both impact and having fun along the way.
  
Join us at Telavox
  
Since Telavox's journey started in 2002, we have strengthened our position as the leading forward-thinking communication platform for businesses. As a digital mobile operator, we develop and own our all-in-one communication platform, which integrates telephony, PBX, messaging, meetings, and contact centers, giving businesses a smarter way to connect.
  
Today, we’re a thriving company with 1.9 billion SEK in revenue and 500+ Telavoxers across nine countries. We embrace AI and automation to push the boundaries of business communication.
  
We offer flexible work options and adaptable hours, giving you the freedom to balance life and career while staying connected to our vibrant Telavox culture.
  
Read more about our new HQ in Malmö !
  
How to apply!
  
At Telavox, we don't focus on fitting in; we focus on making room for everyone.
  
We’re always on the lookout for great talent, so applications are reviewed continuously. If you're ready to be part of an innovative, AI-driven telecom company, apply today with your CV and cover letter in English.
  
Learn more about what we do! ⬇️

title: Product Cybersecurity Verification & Validation Engineer to ABB Robotics
description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.


This role sits within ABB's Robotics business, a leading global robotics company. We're entering an exciting new chapter as we’ve announced the plan for SoftBank Group to acquire ABB Robotics. SoftBank is a globally recognized technology group and investor/operator focused on AI, robotics, and next-generation computing. By joining us now, you’ll be part of a pioneering team shaping the future of robotics—working alongside world-class experts in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment.


This Position reports to:


R&D Global Unit Lead**Your role and responsibilities**
----------------------------------


Within ABB Robotics’ cybersecurity organization, the Product Security Assurance Center (PSAC) is establishing an internal capability for Product Cybersecurity Verification & Validation in accordance with IEC 62443 standards. Operating from the offices in Västerås, the Center provides centralized security testing and compliance validation for ABB Robotics' entire global product portfolio. Join us on this journey to build this critical security function!


We seek a skilled **Product Cybersecurity Verification & Validation Engineer** to join our Product Security Assurance Center (PSAC) and support in testing across the Robotics portfolio. You will perform *vulnerability testing, penetration testing, protocol stack robustness assessment, and compliance validation* supporting R&D to deliver a best-in-class solution to our costumers


This position requires regular on-site presence in Västerås for hands-on security testing in the PSAC laboratory, with remote work flexibility for documentation, analysis, and research activities.

**In this role, your main accountable for:**

* Manage full lifecycle of PSAC testing requests, reviewing submitted products for security testing readiness, regulations, and IEC 62443 compliance validation.
* Execute comprehensive security test suites including network security testing, vulnerability scanning, web/mobile/embedded/API security testing, SAST/DAST analysis, penetration testing, and industrial protocol testing.
* Conduct vulnerability analysis and in-depth assessment of security findings, generating comprehensive PSAC reports with actionable recommendations for development teams.
* Research and evaluate security requirement testing methodologies for cloud platforms, APIs, and emerging technologies; create new test methodologies to address evolving threats. Prepare for potential security requirement testing and threat mitigation testing
* Perform hands-on security testing of robotics products in the PSAC laboratory using specialized equipment for network analysis and embedded systems validation.

**Qualifications for the role**
-------------------------------

* Bachelor's or Master's in Cybersecurity, Computer Engineering, or related field.
* 2+ years of hands-on experience in security testing, penetration testing, or vulnerability testing, preferably in industrial automation, robotics, or embedded systems.
* In-depth knowledge of TCP/IP networking, application protocols, and industrial control communication protocols.
* Proficiency with security testing tools and processes.
* Experience with embedded systems security, and IoT/OT security.
* Knowledge of industrial protocols (EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, OPC UA), and cryptographic protocols (SSL/TLS).
* Programming/scripting proficiency for test automation
* Excellent technical writing skills and ability to work independently and collaboratively.
* Verbal and written fluency in English

**Additional Merits:**

* Professional certifications
* Knowledge of IEC 62443 standard
* Demonstrated curiosity and passion for learning emerging security technologies and attack techniques.
* Experience with hardware exploitation, side-channel analysis, or IoT security.

**More about us**
-----------------

title: Spare Parts & Aftersales Coordinator - Part-time 16 hours/week

title: Financial Controller till kund i Ljungby!
description:
Är du en erfaren Financial Controller som trivs nära verksamheten och vill kombinera operativt ekonomiarbete med analys, rapportering och verksamhetsstöd? Nu söker vi dig som vill kliva in i ett spännande konsultuppdrag hos en större och välkänd aktör inom logistik.


I rollen blir du en del av ett centralt finansteam och får en viktig position i att stötta den operativa verksamheten genom effektiva finansiella processer, analys och uppföljning.

#### **Praktiska detaljer:**


**Plats:** Ljungby  

**Start:** 5 oktober 2026  

**Uppdragsperiod:** Till 31 december 2026, med möjlighet till förlängning  

**Omfattning:** Heltid 100 %  

**Hybridarbete:** Möjlighet till distansarbete, med fysisk närvaro minst 3 dagar i veckan

### **Om rollen**


Som Financial Controller arbetar du nära både finansteamet och den operativa verksamheten. Du har löpande kontakt med verksamhetens logistikenheter och bidrar med såväl finansiell kompetens som analys och stöd i det dagliga arbetet.


Rollen passar dig som tycker om att kombinera struktur och noggrannhet med ett verksamhetsnära och lösningsorienterat arbetssätt. Du är bekväm med att ta eget ansvar, prioritera mellan olika arbetsuppgifter och snabbt sätta dig in i nya processer och system.

### **Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter**

**Du kommer bland annat att:**

* Arbeta operativt inom centrala finansprocesser såsom kundfakturering (Order to Cash), leverantörsfakturor (Purchase to Pay) och bokslut (Record to Report).
* Stötta verksamheten med månadsrapportering, statistik och analys av finansiella data.
* Bidra i budget- och prognosarbetet.
* Säkerställa att finansiella rutiner, processer och övergripande policys efterlevs.
* Samarbeta nära den operativa verksamheten och bygga förtroendefulla relationer med olika delar av organisationen.

### **Vi söker dig som har**

* Cirka 5 års erfarenhet som ekonomiadministratör och/eller Controller inom **logistik**.
* Goda kunskaper i **SAP eller annat ERP-system**.
* Mycket goda kunskaper i **Microsoft Excel och Office-paketet**.
* God kommunikativ förmåga på **svenska och engelska**, i både tal och skrift.


Det är meriterande om du har en akademisk examen inom ekonomi samt erfarenhet av Business Intelligence-verktyg såsom **QlikView, Microsoft Power BI eller SAP Analytics Cloud**.

### **Vem är du?**


För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du är självgående, kommunikativ och lösningsorienterad. Du arbetar strukturerat och noggrant samtidigt som du har förmågan att behålla fokus när tempot är högt.


Du har ett analytiskt förhållningssätt, tar ansvar för dina leveranser och är van vid att självständigt prioritera ditt arbete. Eftersom rollen innebär många kontaktytor är det också viktigt att du uppskattar samarbete och har lätt för att skapa förtroendefulla relationer på olika nivåer i en organisation.

### **Låter det intressant?**


Skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt. Urval och presentation av kandidater sker löpande, vilket innebär att uppdraget kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.


Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

title: PhD student in Computer and Systems Sciences, with focus on Internet of Things and Machine Learning
description:
**The Department of Computer and Systems Sciences.** With over 200 employees and 4,500 students, the Department of Computer and Systems Sciences (DSV) is a strong and dynamic research and educational environment. The discipline of computer and systems sciences bridges the gap between technology and the humanities, social sciences, and behavioral sciences, with great relevance to our lives today and in the future. Our research addresses how new information and communication technology should be designed to benefit people, organizations and entire societies.


DSV offers a stimulating research community in an international environment. As a doctoral student at DSV, you study together with many other doctoral students, collaborate with senior research colleagues and get connected to other researchers in Sweden and abroad. DSV’s location is Stockholm University's campus in Kista, north of central Stockholm.


More information about us, please visit: the Department of Computer and Systems Sciences.

**Project description**
-----------------------

**Resource-Efficient On-Device AI/ML for IoT Systems**  

This PhD project investigates resource-efficient multimodal machine learning for intelligent Internet of Things systems. It will explore models that integrate sensor time series, images, audio, video, and text to support real-time, context-aware decision-making on constrained devices. The research will examine multimodal data fusion, compact vision-language and time-series models, quantization, model compression, hardware-aware optimization, and adaptive inference. It will also investigate subgroup identification, subgroup fairness, and group-level counterfactual methods for detecting and mitigating biases across users, devices, environments, and operating conditions. Cloud-edge processing will be considered when fully local execution becomes impractical. Intelligent data-exchange mechanisms and data protocols will support efficient device communication. Potential applications include smart buildings, industrial systems, wearable-data analysis, environmental monitoring, and decision-support systems for assisted and autonomous driving.


The project is part of a vibrant academic community with a strong international network, offering opportunities for interdisciplinary collaboration, seminars, and scientific exchange within both academia and industry. In addition to a competitive salary and wellness benefits, the candidate is offered strong support for academic development, including funding for books, conference travel, and professional growth opportunities.

**Qualification requirements**
------------------------------


In order to be admitted to postgraduate education, the applicant must have the general and specific entry requirements. The qualification requirements must be met by the deadline for applications.


You meet **general entry requirements** if you have completed a second-cycle degree, or completed courses equivalent to at least 240 higher education credits, of which 60 credits must be in the second cycle, or have otherwise acquired equivalent knowledge in Sweden or elsewhere.

**Specific entry requirements** are described in the general syllabus for doctoral studies in the field of Computer and Systems Sciences and state that the applicant must have completed courses at second-cycle level in Computer and Systems Sciences with a minimum of 60 higher education credits or equivalent. The applicant must also have completed a degree project (thesis) of at least 15 higher education credits. In addition, the applicant is required to have English language skills equivalent of Common European Framework of Reference for Languages Level B2.

**Selection**
-------------


The selection among the eligible candidates will be based on their capacity to benefit from the training. The following criteria will be used to assess this capacity:

* Independence in the analysis and organization of the earlier scientific work
* Problem formulation and rigor in previous scientific work and in the research plan
* Previously shown ability to keep the specified time limits
* Methodological and scientific maturity
* Communication and cooperation skills
* Subject specific knowledge relevant to education.


Admission Regulations for Doctoral Studies at Stockholm University.

**About the employment**
------------------------


We offer a fixed-term employment as a doctoral student according to Chapter 5 of the Higher Education Ordinance (1993:100). The period of employment may not be longer than what corresponds to full-time doctoral education for four years. As a doctoral student, you should primarily devote yourself to your own doctoral education, but the employment may include work with education, research and administration to a limited extent (maximum 20 %).


A new employment as a doctoral student is for a maximum of one year, the employment is then renewed for a maximum of two years at a time.


Stockholm University strives to be a workplace free from discrimination and with equal opportunities for all.

**Contact**
-----------


For more information, please contact Associate Professor Praveen Kumar Donta, praveen.donta@dsv.su.se, or Director of PhD studies, Åsa Smedberg, studierektorF@dsv.su.se.

**Application**
---------------


Apply for the PhD student position at Stockholm University's recruitment system. Attach a personal letter and CV as well as the attachments requested in the application form. It is the responsibility of the applicant to ensure that the application is complete in accordance with the instructions in the job advertisement, and that it is submitted before the deadline. We recommend that the application, with associated documents, be written in English.


The instructions for applicants are available at: How to apply for a position.


Stockholm University contributes to the development of sustainable democratic society through knowledge, enlightenment and the pursuit of truth.

**Project description**
-----------------------

**Security, Privacy and Trust in Intelligent and Distributed Systems**  

The rapid digitalization of society, together with the proliferation of artificial intelligence (AI), Internet-of-Things (IoT) devices, cloud computing, and next-generation communication networks, has greatly expanded the cyber threat landscape. Ensuring the security, privacy, trust, and resilience of intelligent and distributed systems has therefore become one of the most important scientific and technological challenges of our time.


This Ph.D. project aims to advance the state of the art in network and information security by developing novel methods, algorithms, system architectures, and evaluation frameworks for securing modern intelligent and distributed systems. The project lies at the intersection of cybersecurity, AI, and distributed systems, combining mathematically grounded security mechanisms with practical system design and implementation to address both fundamental scientific questions and real-world challenges.


The successful candidate will conduct cutting-edge research on the security of AI-enabled distributed systems and the use of AI to secure large-scale networked systems and infrastructures. Potential research directions include, but are not limited to:

* Security, robustness, and privacy of generative and agentic AI systems, as well as intelligent network services;
* Trustworthy and explainable AI for critical infrastructures and cyber-physical systems;
* AI-assisted cybersecurity mechanisms;
* Security and privacy of cloud, edge, and distributed systems;
* Privacy-enhancing technologies;
* Secure protocols and cryptographic mechanisms for intelligent and distributed systems;
* Security analytics based on graph learning and large-scale data analysis.


The research will involve both theoretical investigations and experimental system development. Depending on the specific research direction, the project may include mathematical modelling and formal security analysis, machine learning and data analytics, large-scale simulations, prototype implementation, and empirical evaluation in realistic environments. Particular emphasis will be placed on research that integrates rigorous security analysis and mathematical foundations with the design, implementation, and evaluation of secure, trustworthy and intelligent distributed systems.

title: Data Architect for Data Collection | SEB, Stockholm
description:
SEB is more than a bank. We are a technology-driven financial institution where everything starts from our customer needs and business outcomes. AI, data and modern engineering are natural parts of how we work, build and deliver value. From core banking platforms to agentic AI, automation, cybersecurity and cloud, we offer a broad tech landscape and many paths to grow. Together, we are shaping secure, responsible and future- proof solutions for our customers and society. Are you ready to take on a new challenge?



Finance, Risk, and Compliance are undergoing a major transformation—driven by business and regulatory changes as well as significant shifts in architectural design. We are therefore looking for a Data Architect with experience in data modelling to develop an integrated data architecture that meets regulatory requirements and business needs. You will be a vital part of our community driving the Finance, Risk, and Compliance agenda in the bank.


**About the role:**



As a Data Architect for Data Collection in our team, you will take responsibility for the data modelling within the data collection tribe. In data collection tribe we are responsible to collect and harmonise data from all of SEB group and make it available for consumption in Finance, Risk and Compliance. The tribe has started the journey to replace our legacy data warehouse by a new solution. As a Data Architect you will contribute to the data design of the new data warehouse and to defining how to transition away from the legacy warehouse. Your work will involve a high degree of complexity, both from a business and data perspective as well as from a people and process perspective. You’ll work closely with business stakeholders and architects to:


* Develop harmonised business information and logical data models that reflect the data needs of Finance, Risk and Compliance, support metadata capture, consistency, lineage, and traceability across the data landscape.
* Support the establishment of common business terminology and data definitions, helping create consistency and understanding across stakeholders, processes, and reporting.
* Contribute to compliance with BCBS 239, Basel/CRR, IFRS, and other applicable regulatory requirements, and alignment with the domain architecture.
* Collaborate with stakeholders from the data collection tribe, data management professionals, and architects across Finance, Risk, and Compliance.


**To thrive in this role, we believe you have:**


* Subject matter expertise - solid knowledge of the financial instruments – both from the trading and the lending side, collateral and party data
* Experience working with harmonised business information and logical data models, data definitions, data mapping, data flows, or similar disciplines that help structure and govern business-critical data.
* Strong understanding of data warehouse architecture and modeling approaches, including Data Vault 2.0, Inmon, and Kimball, with the ability to assess their strengths and determine when each approach is most appropriate.
* Good understanding of how data is managed and consumed across organisations, including reporting, analytics, regulatory processes, and modern data management practices.
* Ability to bridge business and data perspectives and translate complex requirements into clear and practical information structures.
* Strong problem-solving and critical thinking skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with a positive, solution‑oriented mindset.
* Excellent communication and documentation skills to convey complex ideas effectively to both business and IT professionals.
* Fluency in English.


**What we offer:**


* A key role in one of SEB’s most challenging areas
* Innovative working environment with highly motivated colleagues
* Agile and modern ways of working
* Hybrid work model, meaning remote work is possible up to 2 days/week
* Attractive compensation and access to SEB staff banking with exclusive benefits


**Do you want to be part of SEB?**  

It is our fundamental belief that inclusion and diversity is crucial to our future success. We strive to have an inclusive, value-driven culture where employees feel valued, respected, and involved irrespective of who they are, what they believe or where they come from.



Since we select candidates continuously, feel free to send in your application today via the link in this ad, but no later than September 25th.



Please be aware that our final candidates undergo background checks, a process that includes for example identity control, verification of qualifications, credit checks, company engagements and history of crime. In some cases, we also apply random drug checks. During employment, employees within SEB can also expect to undergo recurring background checks.



SEB Sweden has a redeployment responsibility, why this position might be covered by internal redeployment

title: Full-Stack Engineer - Creative Studio
description:
**About ElevenLabs**
--------------------


ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.


We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.  

  

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

* ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
* ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
* ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.


Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

**How we work**
---------------

* **High-velocity:** Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
* **Impact not job titles:** We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
* **AI first:** We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
* **Excellence everywhere:** Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
* **Global team:** We prioritize your talent, not your location.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* **Innovative culture:** You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
* **Growth paths:** Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
* **Learning & development**: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
* **Social travel**: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
* **Annual company offsite:** Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
* **Co-working**: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

**About the role**
------------------


We are looking for Full-Stack Engineers to develop and maintain both front-end and back-end components of our Creative & Studio products. These include the Image/Video, Flows, Agentic Creation, Audiobooks and Music/Studio features.

**Your general responsibilities will include:**
-----------------------------------------------

* Building and maintaining our products and platform on top of our cutting-edge voice models, which will be used by millions of users.
* High degrees of ownership. Developing the product roadmap, and running experiments on some of our enterprise ventures across Creative Platform, Music, and GenAI.
* Collaborating closely with others on the Engineering, Growth and Sales teams to understand, and design solutions for, our customer and internal team’s most important problems and workflows.
* Building end-to-end API and Core Engineering workflows for enterprise customers, with potential ML involvement: generative output quality on Image/Video models


We believe in pairing engineers with work that matches their strengths and interests. This means that there is significant flexibility in staffing engineers across the company.


**Specific responsibilities might include:**
--------------------------------------------

* Strong product engineering mindset, able to build 0 > 1 (API through to UI). Scoping and building brand new proof of concept products, sometimes directly with partner customers, that could later be scaled to capture entirely new markets.
* Improving our existing products to ensure that they’re intuitive, powerful and make innovative use of our research team’s latest break-throughs. This could involve making sweeping architecture changes, adding significant functionality, or building integrations with other common consumer/enterprise solutions.
* Maintaining and strengthening our internal infrastructure as we scale and grow to ensure that our products remain live, performant and secure.
* Working to collect, manage, and process massive-scale datasets to lay the groundwork for the next generation of voice models at the forefront of generative AI.

**Requirements**
----------------


We do not require any formal experience, certifications, or degrees. Instead, we are seeking enthusiastic software engineers who can showcase solving impressively hard problems with artifacts such as past projects, designs, or GitHub contributions.


**We do require:**

* Expertise in Python
* Experience with Web Development using Typescript/React
* Familiarity with common software and system design patterns and infrastructure including APIs, cloud infrastructure tools, storage solutions, data structures etc.
* Experience designing APIs, platform reliability, and building products at scale
* Bonus: experience deploying products directly to enterprise customers, or ML/GenAI exposure

**Location**
------------


This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in Bangalore, Dublin, London, New York, San Francisco, Tokyo, and Warsaw.

Join Handelsbanken's AI & Automation department as a Senior AI Platform Engineer and help shape the future of Sweden's most trusted bank. **Your team**  

We are on a mission to lead the industry in AI & Automation, delivering smarter products, services, and experiences for our customers. Our cross-functional team, consisting of Data/Platform Engineers and a Product Manager, combines deep technical expertise with a passion for innovation. Together, we design scalable solutions that leverage statistics, machine learning, and GenAI to solve real business challenges across the bank.
  

  

**Your role**  

As a Senior AI Platform Engineer, you will be key in developing and maintaining our hybrid data platforms. You will use your expertise to design efficient data and machine learning pipelines that serve as the foundation for our AI initiatives. Our environments span both on-premises and cloud platforms, so you should enjoy hands-on engineering, especially in Linux environments; bonus points if you prefer working in the terminal.


We believe DevOps and solid software engineering practices are essential to delivering AI in production, enabling branch offices and business teams to use the insights and models we create. You will collaborate closely with Data Engineers, ML Engineers, and Data Scientists to ensure our platforms are robust, scalable, and ready for innovation. If you are a seasoned engineer who enjoys working end-to-end, from data sourcing and transformation to operationalising models, and want to advance CI/CD and ML pipelines in a complex regulated environment, this is a great opportunity to make a real impact.

You are skilled in software development, with proficiency in Python and SQL, and have a strong understanding of system design.


You have built and maintained data pipelines, ideally using tools such as dbt and Prefect, and you are experienced with containerised development in Linux. You are willing to learn, or already have, Swedish language skills. Knowledge of infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform or Ansible is a plus.


As a person, you have excellent problem-solving skills and enjoy tackling challenges with code. You are curious and inventive, continuously striving to learn and improve. You share our commitment to being smart, humble, and, above all, collaborative.

At Handelsbanken, you will join a stable, values-driven organisation that invests long-term in people and technology. You will have the opportunity to contribute to our AI transformation, in an environment that values trust, collaboration, and sustainable innovation.
