title: Engineering Manager
description:
### **Join Telavox as an Engineering Manager**


At Telavox, we’re looking for an Engineering Manager who is comfortable leading inside a fast-moving organisation, someone who can hold a team steady while priorities shift and knows how to introduce just enough structure to make a team faster, not slower. You’ll combine leading people with strong engineering judgement, and you’ll care as much about how reliably your team ships as about how quickly they move.


If you enjoy working with people, leading through change, and empowering teams to do their best work, this is your opportunity to make a real difference.

#### **About the job**


As an Engineering Manager at Telavox, you’ll lead our Telephony Team, responsible for developing people, strengthening team performance, and aligning engineering efforts with business and product goals.


The Telephony Team works on core telephony capabilities and collaborates closely with other engineering and product teams. You’ll help shape effective processes and ways of working, manage dependencies, and ensure clear technical contracts and interfaces between teams.


You’ll work closely with engineers, Product, and other stakeholders, contributing to technical discussions and architectural decisions while ensuring the team delivers scalable and sustainable solutions.

**Your day-to-day work will include:**

* Leading, coaching, and developing the Telephony Team, supporting growth, performance, and well-being
* Establishing effective processes and ways of working, adding structure where needed and removing it where it isn’t
* Creating clarity when priorities shift and translating business needs into clear plans
* Partnering with Product on priorities, roadmaps, and outcomes; delivering a highly scalable and competitive telephony platform
* Collaborating with other Engineering Managers and teams on dependencies, technical contracts, and interfaces
* Contributing to technical and architectural decisions and ensuring long-term scalability, availability, and maintainability
* Contributing to hiring and building a strong, inclusive, and diverse engineering team in a collaborative and high-performing environment
* Helping shape the broader engineering strategy, technical direction, and culture across engineering teams

#### **About you**


You’re a confident engineering leader who is comfortable with ambiguity, able to create clarity, and interested in understanding the bigger picture. As the leader of the Telephony Team, you’ll work across a broad technical landscape, from core telephony to cloud, software architecture, and operations. You don’t need to be an expert in every area, but you have solid technical understanding, curiosity, and a willingness to learn.


You may come from a Senior or Lead Engineer background and stay close enough to technology to make sound decisions around architecture, quality, reliability, and trade-offs.

**Key skills and experience we’re looking for:**

* Proven experience leading engineering teams as an Engineering Manager, Tech Lead, or similar
* Strong people leadership skills, including coaching, mentoring, and developing individuals
* Experience creating effective processes, ways of working, and structures that help teams perform
* Comfortable with ambiguity and able to turn changing priorities into clear direction
* Solid technical understanding and curiosity across different technologies and domains
* Experience working with production software where reliability, quality, and maintainability matter
* Ability to connect engineering decisions to product and business priorities, and challenge constructively when needed
* Passion for building a healthy, inclusive, and high-performing team culture

**Good-to-have skills:**

* Good understanding of telephony concepts such as SIP, RTP, and related technologies
* Experience from a SaaS or B2B environment
* Familiarity with cloud architecture, event-driven systems, and DevOps practices
* Interest in using AI tooling to improve engineering ways of working


At Telavox, you’ll have the opportunity to grow as a leader, shape how we build software, and be part of a company that values both impact and having fun along the way.

#### **Join us at Telavox**


Since Telavox's journey started in 2002, we have strengthened our position as the leading forward-thinking communication platform for businesses. As a digital mobile operator, we develop and own our all-in-one communication platform, which integrates telephony, PBX, messaging, meetings, and contact centers, giving businesses a smarter way to connect.  

  

Today, we’re a thriving company with 1.9 billion SEK in revenue and 500+ Telavoxers across nine countries. We embrace AI and automation to push the boundaries of business communication.  

  

We offer flexible work options and adaptable hours, giving you the freedom to balance life and career while staying connected to our vibrant Telavox culture.


Read more about our new HQ in Malmö !

### **How to apply!**


At Telavox, we don't focus on fitting in; we focus on making room for everyone.  

  

We’re always on the lookout for great talent, so applications are reviewed continuously. If you're ready to be part of an innovative, AI-driven telecom company, apply today with your CV and cover letter in English.

 **Learn more about what we do! ️**

title: Content Creator - Video & E-Commerce
description:
Vesani fortsätter att växa och söker nu en Content Creator med inriktning mot video och motion som vill vara med och utveckla vårt visuella uttryck och hur våra produkter presenteras digitalt.
  
Vi söker en kreativ och operativ person som både kan skapa en snabb Reel för sociala medier och producera en genomarbetad, elegant produktfilm för en större lansering.
  
Men rollen är bredare än video. Precis som resten av vårt contentteam kommer du att arbeta operativt med vår e-commerce: bygga och publicera produkter, arbeta med innehåll i Magento 2 och producera material för webb, kampanjer och produktlanseringar.
  
Video och rörligt innehåll blir ditt specialistområde, medan e-commerce och contentproduktion utgör den gemensamma kärnan i rollen.
  
Din roll
  
E-commerce & CMS
  
En betydande del av rollen innebär att arbeta operativt med innehållet på vesani.se. Du kommer bland annat att:
  
Skapa, bygga och publicera produkter i Magento 2
  
  

Arbeta i Magento Page Builder
  
  

Bygga och uppdatera kategori-, kampanj- och landningssidor
  
  

Arbeta med produkttexter, bilder, specifikationer och annat produktinnehåll
  
  

Skapa och anpassa visuellt material för webbplatsen
  
  

Producera material i Adobe Creative Cloud och Canva
  
  

Arbeta nära e-commerce- och marknadsteamet kring kampanjer och produktlanseringar
  
  

Hos oss handlar content inte bara om idéer – du behöver också kunna ta dem hela vägen till färdigt och publicerat material.
  
Video, Motion & Performance Creative
  
Du får ett särskilt ansvar för att utveckla Vesanis rörliga innehåll – från organiskt material för sociala medier till produktfilmer, kampanjer och material för betald marknadsföring.
  
  

**Du kommer bland annat att:**  

Filma och producera Reels, TikToks och annat short-form content
  
  

Skapa genomarbetade produkt- och kampanjfilmer
  
  

Filma produkter, miljöer, showroom och lanseringar
  
  

Planera produktion från idé och storyboard till färdig film
  
  

Redigera och anpassa material för olika digitala kanaler
  
  

Arbeta med motion graphics, typografi och animation
  
  

Arbeta med färgkorrigering, ljud och efterbearbetning
  
  

Skapa kreativa variationer, hooks och budskap för Meta och Google
  
  

Du behöver kunna växla mellan snabbt och relevant content som går från idé till publicering på kort tid och genomarbetade premiumproduktioner där foto, rörelse, klippning, ljud och efterbearbetning tillsammans bygger produktens och varumärkets känsla.
  
Performance Marketing – meriterande
  
Erfarenhet av Meta Ads och Google Ads är ett stort plus. Vi uppskattar särskilt kandidater som förstår sambandet mellan kreativ produktion och kommersiellt resultat.
  
Det är meriterande om du har arbetat med creative testing, annonsvarianter och performance-data och förstår hur hooks, budskap och kreativa format påverkar resultatet.
  
Du behöver inte vara performance marketing-specialist. Det viktigaste är att du är en stark contentproducent – men kombinationen av kreativ förmåga och förståelse för digital annonsering värdesätter vi högt.
  
Verktyg & AI
  
Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop och Lightroom. Erfarenhet av Canva är också värdefull.
  
Det viktigaste är dock inte exakt vilka program du använder idag, utan kvaliteten på det du skapar, ditt visuella öga och din förmåga att snabbt lära dig nya verktyg.
  
Vi arbetar aktivt med AI-baserad contentproduktion och experimenterar med att kombinera traditionell foto- och videoproduktion med generativ AI. Erfarenhet av AI för bild, video eller text är meriterande, men inget krav. För oss är nyfikenheten viktigare än tidigare erfarenhet.
  
Vi tror att du
  
Har erfarenhet av att skapa och redigera video
  
  

Har ett starkt visuellt öga och mycket god känsla för estetik
  
  

Förstår bildkomposition, ljus, tempo och storytelling
  
  

Kan skapa både snabbt socialt content och genomarbetade produktioner
  
  

Har erfarenhet av Adobe Creative Cloud
  
  

Är bekväm med digitala system och CMS
  
  

Kan driva en produktion från idé till publicering
  
  

Är självgående, initiativtagande och lösningsorienterad
  
  

Har hög yrkesstolthet och känsla för detaljer
  
  

Trivs med varierande arbetsuppgifter och högt tempo
  
  

Är nyfiken och vill fortsätta lära och utvecklas
  
  

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper. Du behöver inte kunna allt från början – men vi förväntar oss att du vill förstå, lära dig och utvecklas.
  
Meriterande
  
**Erfarenhet av ett eller flera av följande områden är ett plus:**
  
After Effects och motion graphics
  
  

Produktfilm, fotografering och ljussättning
  
  

Performance marketing, Meta Ads eller Google Ads
  
  

E-commerce och Magento, Shopify eller annat CMS
  
  

AI-baserad bild-, video- eller textproduktion
  
  

Organiskt innehåll för Instagram och TikTok
  
  

Att vara bekväm framför kameran – ett plus, men inget krav
  
  

Krav
  
Erfarenhet av content- och videoproduktion
  
  

God erfarenhet av videoredigering
  
  

Flytande svenska i tal och skrift
  
  

Goda kunskaper i engelska
  
  

B-körkort
  
  

För att lyckas hos oss
  
En av de viktigaste egenskaperna vi söker är nyfikenhet.
  
Contentproduktion, e-commerce och digital marknadsföring förändras snabbt. Vi söker därför inte någon som bara kan sitt nuvarande arbetssätt, utan någon som vill förstå vad som kommer härnäst, testar nya verktyg och omsätter idéer till innehåll som faktiskt blir färdigt och publicerat.
  
Du behöver trivas i en miljö med korta beslutsvägar där en idé snabbt kan gå från diskussion till genomförande. Vi värdesätter personer som tar initiativ, hittar lösningar och driver sitt arbete framåt.
  
Vi erbjuder
  
En trygg anställning i ett finansiellt starkt och växande bolag
  
  

Stor kreativ frihet och möjlighet att påverka Vesanis visuella uttryck
  
  

En bred roll som kombinerar e-commerce, video och digital contentproduktion
  
  

Produkter och miljöer med stora möjligheter till kreativ produktion
  
  

Möjlighet att utvecklas inom video, e-commerce, performance marketing och AI
  
  

Friskvårdsbidrag, personalrabatter och andra förmåner
  
  

Gratis frukost vissa dagar i veckan
  
  

Bärbar dator och mobiltelefon
  
  

Ett sammansvetsat team med korta beslutsvägar
  
  

Ansökan
  
Skicka din ansökan tillsammans med portfolio, showreel eller exempel på videoproduktioner till jobb@vesani.se.
  
Visa gärna både snabbare socialt content och mer genomarbetade produktioner. Har du erfarenhet av Meta Ads, Google Ads, AI eller performance creative får du gärna även visa exempel på detta.
  
Urval sker löpande.
  
Tjänsten är på heltid och utgår från vårt kontor och showroom i Ängelholm. Tjänsten inleds med 6 månaders provanställning.
  
Vesani Sweden AB
  
Transportgatan 6
  
262 71 Ängelholm

description:

Office**Job Description**


The Marketing Automation Specialist within the RSD EU Digital Marketing team is responsible for executing and optimizing automated, personalized customer journeys(email, web) that drive engagement, conversion, and retention.  

  

This role focuses on building and managing data-driven customer journeys that deliver the right message to the right customer at the right moment. By leveraging behavioral, transactional, and CRM data, the specialist supports lifecycle programs across customer onboarding, growth, re-engagement and retention, ensuring relevant communication that contributes to both revenue growth and sales effectiveness.  

  

Journeys are served through a modern Mar-Tech including Adobe Experience Platform (AEP), Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO), and Oracle Eloqua. This role translates data and campaign requirements into scalable, automated journeys. The specialist plays a key role in ensuring campaigns are executed with high relevancy, hyper personalized, and continuously optimized based on performance insights.  

  

Close collaboration with regional marketing teams, sales, content, and MarTech stakeholders is essential to ensure campaigns align with business priorities and deliver consistent, high-quality customer experiences.

**Key responsibilities:**

* Build, launch, and manage email campaigns and automated customer journeys across the lifecycle, including onboarding, cross-/upsell, reactivation, and retention.
* Execute in partnership with our Studio team email campaigns and support journey orchestration in Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) and Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO).
* Apply audience segmentation and behavioral data to enable targeted and personalized communication based on segmentation strategy.
* Implement dynamic content, product recommendations, and educational & promotional messaging aligned with customer lifecycle stage.
* Monitor campaign performance and track key KPIs (e.g., open rate, CTR, conversions, attributed revenue), identifying opportunities for optimization to drive bigger business impact.
* Support A/B testing and experimentation to improve campaign effectiveness and engagement.
* Collaborate with marketing, sales, and Studio teams to ensure campaigns support customer engagement and commercial objectives.
* Ensure campaign quality, accuracy, and timely delivery across all programs.
* Actively drive marketing opt-in growth increasing our customer base reach.
* Maintain data quality and support proper audience selection and segmentation within marketing systems.
* Ensure compliance with GDPR and internal data governance standards, including consent and data usage policies.
* Support continuous improvement of campaign processes, workflows, and automation structures.

**Skills:**

* Very strong understanding of email marketing, customer lifecycle marketing, and personalization principles.
* Hands-on experience with marketing automation platforms (e.g., Eloqua, Marketo, Salesforce Marketing Cloud) is preferred.
* Experience or familiarity with modern marketing technology stacks, including Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) and Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO).
* Understanding of and experience with CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce) and audience segmentation.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret campaign data and translate it into actionable improvements.
* Basic knowledge of HTML for email editing is a plus.
* Strong attention to detail and focus on execution quality.
* Good project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously.
* Strong communication and stakeholder collaboration skills.
* Commercial awareness and understanding of how marketing contributes to revenue and customer retention.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in email marketing, marketing automation, or lifecycle marketing across multiple customer segments at region or global level in a corporate organization.
* Proven experience executing automated, data-driven email campaigns and customer life cycle journeys.
* Proven track record delivering profitable revenue growth through email marketing automation
* Experience working in a matrixed, international organization is a plus.
* Fluency in English.

**Non-Negotiable Hiring Criteria:**

* Hands-on experience with email marketing and marketing automation tools like Saleforce, Eloqua, Adobe Journey Optimizer, etc.
* Experience working with expert agencies in the marketing automation field.
* Business driven mindset to deliver business impact in a high performing team.
* Comfortable working with data and performance metrics to improve campaigns.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Collaborative growth mindset and ability to work with cross-functional teams.
* Proactive, structured, and eager to learn and improve.

title: Sr. Solutions Architecture Manager, Amazon Web Services, Sweden
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for an experienced Sr. Solutions Architect Manager to lead the Swedish solutions architecture team, that helps customers across multiple industries succeed using AWS technologies.
  

  

In this role, you will hire and develop some of the industry’s best cloud-based solutions architects, coach them on cloud adoption best practices, empower them to further develop their technical areas of depth as well as their communication, presentation and strategic advisory skills. You will be partnering with other teams within AWS such as account management, service teams, marketing, and professional services, prioritizing your initiatives and aligning goals to maximize long term value.
  

  

You and your team will shape and deliver on a strategy to build mind share and broad use of AWS services in Sweden. You will be interacting directly with customers to better understand their needs and align the right resources and tools to maximize their success. You will be measuring and delivering results, while staying in touch with the pace of innovation of the AWS technology and its use cases. You will need to be technically capable and credible in your own right so that you can shape the customer and solutions-focused initiatives of your team. You will get to practice your creativity in driving the link of technology to tangible solutions and educating customers about the art of the possible. Central to this will be your leadership in driving Solutions Architects to create advanced solutions, demos and architectures for a variety of use cases.
  

  

The ideal candidate has experience building, leading and developing talented teams of senior engineers or solutions architects. Customer-facing experience is preferred, practical knowledge of the AWS platform is desired but not required, provided you have sound leadership skills and a strong technical foundation in secure, scalable and reliable IT architectures.
  

  

As the Solutions Architecture Manager for Sweden you will be part of the tech leadership team for Northern Europe, reporting to the area Technology Director.  

  

At Amazon you will be encouraged and rewarded for doing what is right for the long-term success of the customer. We value your passion to discover, invent and build on behalf of customers.
  

  

Amazon has always been, and always will be, committed to diversity and inclusion. We seek builders from all backgrounds to join our teams, and we encourage our employees to bring their authentic, original, and best selves to work.
  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Hire, on-board, train, and develop new Solutions Architects and Solution Architecture Managers; you should be an exceptional builder of great people.
  

  

Coach Solutions Architects to conduct one-to-few and one-to-many technical sessions so they can transfer deep technical skills to customers who are considering or using AWS.
  

  

As the tech leader of Sweden represent AWS in public events and with customers.
  

  

In partnership with account management teams, formulate and execute a customer-focused strategy to drive adoption of AWS.
  

  

Guide and prioritize the development of whitepapers, data sheets, and other high-value customer facing guidance and best practices.
  

  

Own the technical strategy that will increase customer value and adoption of well-architected AWS solutions across customers.
  

  

Act as a conduit and liaison between customers, service engineering teams and support.  

  

About the team  

Diverse Experiences
  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  

  

Why AWS
  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Work/Life Balance

**Description**
 Are you passionate about cloud technology and helping customers innovate?
   

  

 Join our AWS Solutions Architecture team in Sweden and empower Software, SaaS and Technology Companies to innovate at speed and scale with cloud technologies.
   

  

 Solutions Architects work hand in hand with AWS customers to help them make the most of the Cloud. They are at the crossroads of business and technology and engage with organizations at all stages of cloud adoption. Solutions Architects are responsible for creating and presenting technical content and sharing best practices.

They help customer's validate their initiatives from ideation to proof of concept. Solutions Architects lead activities such as architecture reviews, white-boarding sessions, demos and technical workshops. They collaborate with other teams such as account management, professional services, Industry experts, support, service teams and the AWS partner ecosystem.
   

  

 Amongst others you will be part of the design and building of reference architectures, proof of concepts and help customer deploy production workloads on AWS. You will also provide thought leadership and recommendations on cloud architecture, migration, modernization and operation. Build strong technical relationships acting as the voice of the customer internally to influence AWS service roadmaps.

title: Cloud & Infra Arkitekt
description:
Jobba för originalet.
   

  

 Välkommen till Apoteket, nummer ett sedan 1971. Med visioner för framtiden och kvalitet i varje detalj, skapar vi förutsättningar för ett liv i hälsa. Hos oss utvecklas du i en kultur där din röst alltid blir hörd. Och allt vi får över ger vi tillbaka till samhället. Det är så vi gör skillnad på riktigt.
   

  

 Om Enterprisearkitektur på Apoteket
   

  

 Vårt uppdrag är att hitta de bästa och mest hållbara lösningarna utifrån verksamhetens behov och det systemlandskap vi har idag. Det innebär att väga samman allt från tekniska möjligheter och befintliga lösningar till IT-säkerhet, legala krav och långsiktiga behov – och hitta en väg framåt som fungerar för Apoteket som helhet.
   

  

 Arkitektur skapas inte på egen hand, därför är samarbete en viktig del av vår vardag och vi arbetar nära både verksamheten och olika delar av Tech för att förstå behov, utmana perspektiv och tillsammans fatta välgrundade beslut.
   

  

 Samtidigt utvecklar vi hela tiden hur vi arbetar med arkitektur på Apoteket. Vi delar kunskap, skapar gemensamma arbetssätt och gör arkitektur mer tillgängligt i organisationen. Här får du möjlighet att både bidra med din egen specialistkompetens och vara med och påverka hur Apotekets arkitektur utvecklas framåt.
   

  

 Du blir en del av teamet Enterprisearkitektur, där du tillsammans med nio kollegor med kompetens inom lösningsarkitektur, informationsarkitektur, infrastruktur och moln är med och formar Apotekets framtida IT-landskap.
   

  

 Din roll
   

  

 Som Cloud & Infrastruktur Arkitekt har du en central roll i att forma och utveckla Apotekets framtida drift- och infrastrukturmiljöer. Du arbetar rådgivande och nära produktledare, systemarkitekter, lösningsarkitekter och tekniska specialister för att säkerställa att våra lösningar är skalbara, säkra, kostnadseffektiva och anpassade efter verksamhetens behov.
   

  

 I rollen analyserar och designar du lösningar för både cloud-, on-premises- och hybridmiljöer. Du ansvarar för att omsätta verksamhetskrav, tekniska förutsättningar och säkerhetskrav till genomtänkta arkitekturlösningar och konkreta designval.
   

  

 Du arbetar iterativt med lösningsdesign och tar hänsyn till bland annat kapacitet, nätverk, drift, återställning, övervakning och teknisk säkerhet. Lösningarna valideras löpande tillsammans med relevanta intressenter och anpassas för att skapa rätt balans mellan funktion, säkerhet, kvalitet och kostnad.
   

  

 Vad du kommer göra hos oss:
   

  

* Agera rådgivare inom moln- och on-premises-lösningar med särskilt fokus på Microsoft Azure
* Analysera och designa driftmiljöer för cloud-, hybrid- och on-premises-lösningar
* Omsätta verksamhetskrav och tekniska behov till skalbara och hållbara arkitekturlösningar
* Validera och kalibrera krav på SLA, kapacitet, tillgänglighet och prestanda
* Designa lösningar för bland annat nätverk, drift, säkerhetskopiering och återställning
* Identifiera behov inom incidenter, övervakning och tekniska säkerhetsåtgärder
* Säkerställa att lösningar möter Apotekets krav på säkerhet, kvalitet och kostnadseffektivitet
* Samarbeta nära arkitekter, tekniska specialister, produktorganisation och andra intressenter
* Bidra till tekniska vägval, principer och arbetssätt för Apotekets framtida infrastruktur
* Följa utvecklingen inom cloud och infrastruktur och bidra med nya perspektiv och lösningar


 Vem söker vi?
   

  

 För den här rollen söker vi dig som har en gedigen teknisk bakgrund inom infrastruktur och cloud och som trivs i en roll där du kombinerar djup teknisk kompetens med ett brett helhetsperspektiv.
   

  

 Du är van att arbeta med komplexa tekniska miljöer och har förmågan att se hur olika delar inom infrastruktur, cloud, nätverk, säkerhet och drift hänger ihop.
   

  

 Du arbetar strukturerat och analytiskt och kan omsätta komplexa behov till tydliga och genomförbara lösningar.
   

  

 Samtidigt är du kommunikativ och trygg i att samarbeta med olika typer av intressenter. Du kan anpassa din kommunikation efter mottagare och är bekväm med att både utmana befintliga lösningar och argumentera för tekniska vägval.
   

  

 Du är nyfiken och lösningsorienterad och vågar utforska nya angreppssätt när det behövs för att hitta hållbara och effektiva lösningar.
   

  

 Vi ser att du har:
   

  

* Du har akademisk utbildning inom exempelvis datateknik, systemvetenskap eller motsvarande
* Du har erfarenhet av att analysera och designa drift- och infrastrukturmiljöer inom on-premises, cloud och hybrid.
* Du har erfarenhet som Cloud arkitekt eller motsvarande roll med fokus på Microsoft Azure
* Djup kompetens inom Microsoft Azure och god förståelse för moderna cloud-arkitekturer
* Bred teknisk kompetens inom on-premises-infrastruktur och hybridmiljöer
* Du har erfarenhet av att designa skalbara, säkra och kostnadseffektiva infrastrukturlösningar
* Erfarenhet av områden som nätverk, drift, återställning, teknisk säkerhet och övervakning
* God förståelse för teknisk säkerhet och hur säkerhetskrav omsätts i arkitektur och lösningsdesign
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta med komplexa miljöer med många tekniska beroenden och intressenter
* Du har mycket goda kunskaper i svenska & engelska i tal och skrift


**Vi erbjuder...**
* Friskvårdsbidrag: 5000 kr per år.
* Personalrabatt: Förmånliga priser på många av våra produkter.
* Flexibla helgdagar: Möjlighet att byta arbetsfria helgdagar mot andra dagar på året.
* Förmånsportal (Benifex): Erbjudanden inom bland annat kollektivtrafik, leasingbil, gym och hälsobehandlingar.
* Trygga försäkringar: Förstärkt föräldrapenning, tjänstepension (ITP) och kompletterande försäkringar.


**Om oss**
 Apoteket grundades 1971 och ägs av svenska staten, vilket innebär att vi arbetar både ansvarsfullt och långsiktigt. Vårt viktiga samhällsuppdrag handlar om att förbättra människors hälsa, läkemedelsanvändning och bidra till ökad patientsäkerhet. Med omkring 400 apotek och 3000 medarbetare över hela landet har vi nära samarbete med hälso- och sjukvården – alltid med omtanke om både människor och miljö.
   

  

 Vårt mål är tydligt: Ett liv i hälsa, för alla.
   

  

  

**Praktisk information**
 Nyfiken? Det räcker gott.
   

  

 Hör av dig om rollen fångar ditt intresse! Vi berättar gärna mer om tjänsten och vår verksamhet – så du får en tydligare bild och kan avgöra om det känns helt rätt. Vänta bara inte för länge, urval och intervju sker löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum.
   

  

 Skicka ditt CV tillsammans med svar på våra urvalsfrågor. Du behöver inte skriva ett personligt brev – frågorna är utformade för att hjälpa oss förstå mer om dina erfarenheter och kompetenser för matchning mot tjänst.
   

  

 Vi använder tester för objektivt urval som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess. Provanställning tillämpas.
   

  

 Välkommen till Apoteket!

title: Consultant, Data Strategy
description:
We are Analysys Mason, the award-winning specialist management consultancy for technology-intensive industries. We help clients make high stakes technology decisions with confidence, and we turn those decisions into action.
 



  





 Our sector expertise includes telecoms, digital infrastructure, software, IT services, space, defence, manufacturing and logistics.
 



  





 Since 1985 we have grown to 400+ professionals across 17 offices in 13 countries, and our experts have delivered work in more than 140 countries, earning a strong reputation for deep analytical insight and advanced economic modelling.
 



  





 Over more than four decades, Analysys Mason has evolved into a trusted adviser to businesses, investors and governments worldwide. Our experts deliver high-impact results and transformative change across our clients’ most critical strategic, regulatory, technology, transaction and transformation initiatives.
 



  





 Our vision is to be the leading authority and catalyst for digital change, connectivity and inclusion. We help businesses, governments and investors use technology to create a world that is more connected, competitive, sustainable and secure.
 



  





**Job Description** 




  





 We are growing our data and technology strategy practice in the Nordics, and this role will be one of the early hires into the team. You will help clients set their data direction, modernise their platforms and turn plans into lasting change.
 



  





 You will work closely with client leaders, including CDOs, data platform owners and transformation leads. Assignments will range from focused diagnostic work to longer transformation programmes. Depending on your experience, you will manage client projects or lead major workstreams, taking responsibility for the team, day-to-day client relationship, delivery and outcomes. Our teams are small, so you will have real influence from the start and work directly with our Partners and global specialists.
 



  





 In practice, you will:
 



  




* lead data strategy and maturity assessments, covering the current state, target operating model, roadmap and investment case
* shape platform modernisation programmes, from legacy migration and cloud platform design to data products, sourcing choices and vendor selection
* designing data governance and data quality frameworks — ownership, lineage, authoritative sources and SLAs
* help clients make change happen through stakeholder alignment, clear roles and decision-making, practical adoption plans and straightforward programme communication
* manage client projects and workstreams from start to finish, including scope, plan, team coordination, budget, risks, client communication and the quality of the final outcome
* turn complex analysis into clear recommendations and present them confidently to senior client audiences
* help grow the practice by developing reusable approaches, supporting business development and coaching junior colleagues



  





**Qualifications** 




  





 You do not need to tick every box and we welcome candidates from any industry. What matters most is that you know data strategy and platform modernisation, can lead clients and teams and enjoy turning change into something practical. description:

 Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Delivery Consultant you will be proficient in architecting complex, scalable, and secure solutions tailored to meet the specific needs of each customer. title: DevOps Engineer within eHealth
description:
Cambio is one of the Nordics' leading suppliers in e-health with a comprehensive offering for the entire health and care chain. Our e-health solutions supports health care professionals in their daily work and offer patients safer and more easily accessible care. We are proud to be an important part of Swedish healthcare. We are growing continuously and now have about 1000 employees in several countries.

**The position**  

We are looking for a DevOps Engineer who wants to play an active role in how we build, deploy, operate and continuously improve products within Cambio’s Social Care portfolio.


You will work with both modern SaaS and container-based solutions as well as established products used in our customers’ daily operations. Your focus will be on automation, CI/CD, deployment, monitoring and operational reliability across different delivery models.


This is a hands-on role where you will combine technical implementation with collaboration across teams, customers, suppliers and other stakeholders. You will help modernize our delivery processes and influence how DevOps and platform capabilities evolve within Social Care.

**Some of the things you’ll do**

* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and automated release processes.
* Develop and operate container-based environments using Kubernetes or OpenShift.
* Improve deployment processes through automation and Infrastructure as Code.
* Strengthen monitoring, observability and operational reliability.
* Work closely with developers, architects, support and operations.
* Engage with customers, suppliers and internal stakeholders to understand needs and improve delivery models.
* Contribute to the modernization of existing products and services towards more scalable and automated delivery models.

**We offer**  

At Cambio, you do not just work with technology. You help build solutions that support important work in health and social care. You will be part of modernizing an established product portfolio, deepen your skills in DevOps, automation and containerization, and grow through increased responsibility, ownership and technical challenges.


At Cambio, we encourage initiative, continuous learning and knowledge sharing. Our culture is built on Trust, Care and Together.

**About you**  

You have a few years of experience within DevOps, infrastructure, operations, platform engineering or software delivery and are looking for a role where you can take greater ownership while continuing to grow professionally.


You are curious, proactive and enjoy solving problems. You take initiative, learn independently and find practical ways forward, especially in environments where not everything is fully defined.

**We believe you have experience with some of the following**

* DevOps, infrastructure, operations or platform engineering.
* Scripting or automation using PowerShell, Bash, Python or similar.
* CI/CD pipelines and software delivery automation.
* Containers and orchestration platforms such as Docker, Kubernetes or similar.
* Infrastructure automation or Infrastructure as Code.
* Monitoring, logging and observability.
* SQL databases.
* Swedish and English, verbally as well as in writing


Just as important as specific technologies is your ability to learn, take ownership and continuously improve how systems are built, deployed and operated.

 **Place of employment**: Linköping or Motala.

**Scope**: Full-time, hybrid work model (three days per week in-office)

**Form of employment:** Permanent employment, 6 months trial period

**Additional Information:** The role involves access to sensitive information, therefore a background check will be conducted on the final candidate.


We review applications and conduct interviews on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible via the link.  

  

**We look forward to receiving your application!**

Welcome to a company where healthcare is improved every day. Here you will work with leading technology in a collaborative, trusting and empowering environment where your contribution will be appreciated and celebrated. Seize the opportunity to do the most important work of your life**.** Read more about us **here!**

title: Senior R&D Engineer Advanced Electromagnetic Propulsion Systems
description:
Role Overview
  
We are seeking a highly skilled and visionary Senior R&D Engineer (Electromagnetic Propulsion) to lead the physical modelling, simulation, and experimental validation of a next-generation, multistage Electromagnetic Launch System.
  
In this role, you will bridge the gap between advanced physics theory and cutting-edge engineering. You will be responsible for defining the mathematical framework of inductance acceleration, optimizing pulsed-power efficiency, managing extreme thermal/mechanical stresses, and building physical prototypes to validate your models. If you thrive on solving highly complex, multi-physics problems and want to shape the future of high-velocity propulsion tech, this is your next challenge.
  
Core Responsibilities
  
Physics Modelling & Electromagnetic Analysis
  
Develop the fundamental mathematical frameworks and multi-physics models (electromagnetic, thermal, and material physics) to describe inductance acceleration and transient system behaviors.
  
Investigate complex magnetic Lorentz forces, skin effects, and proximity effects acting on coils under high-frequency, time-varying currents.
  
Utilize advanced simulation tools to analyse a large parameter space (coil geometry, shape, size, and turn count) to optimize magnetic field production and projectile acceleration.
  
  

System Architecture & Optimization
  
Design and analyse multistage acceleration configurations, defining the optimal number of stages, mutual stage interactions, and microsecond-level activation timing architectures.
  
Optimize the stored-to-kinetic energy conversion efficiency by minimizing un-utilized magnetic flux, ohmic/resistive losses, and eddy current heating.
  
Define the boundary conditions, switching requirements, pulse shapes, and power regulation dependencies for the electrical and control subsystems.
  
  

Component Design & System Integration
  
Collaborate with external project partners to integrate custom-engineered, high-current pulsed-power coils optimized for mechanical stability and thermal resilience.
  
Oversee the concept design of specialized payloads to ensure seamless compatibility with the electromagnetic launch environment.
  
Address system-level integration challenges arising from high-intensity electromagnetic fields on surrounding components.
  
  

Thermal Management & Power Control
  
Identify transient heat sources within the accelerator stages and propose highly effective thermal management and cooling solutions.
  
Optimize the physical routing of the electrical power supply to the coil inductors to handle extreme stress environments.
  
  

Experimental Validation & Safety
  
Design, build, and operate an experimental test setup to validate simulation data, testing for acceleration efficiency, discharge pulse dynamics, and heat management.
  
Conduct comprehensive safety analyses on high-voltage and high-energy electromagnetic components.
  
Establish strict safety protocols and ensure total compliance with relevant electrical safety standards for pulsed-power operations.
  
  

**Required Technical Skills & Experience:**  

**Education:** Master’s or Ph.D. in Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a highly related field with a focus on Electromagnetics.
  
**Simulation:** Extensive experience with multi-physics simulation software (e.g., COMSOL, Altair Flux, or MATLAB/Simulink) focusing on transient electromagnetic fields.
  
**Pulsed Power Expertise:** Knowledge of inductance acceleration, magnetic forces, high-current switching, and power electronics.
  
**Thermal & Mechanical Insight:** Familiarity with managing thermal dissipation and mechanical stress in high-energy electrical systems.
  
**Hands-on Testing:** Experience setting up laboratory diagnostics, high-speed data acquisition systems, and working safely with high-voltage hardware.
  
Preferred Attributes
  
Experience in advanced aerospace or defence R&D, specifically in coil gun, or linear induction motor technologies.
  
Strong collaborative skills for working alongside external manufacturing and project partners.
  
A meticulous approach to safety protocols and risk analysis.
  
What We Offer
  
**Cutting-Edge Projects:** Work on a disruptive, first-of-its-kind electromagnetic technology program.
  
**Collaborative Culture:** Join a highly collaborative environment alongside leading industry partners and academic experts.
  
**Competitive Compensation:** Attractive salary and continuous professional development paths.
  
Due to the nature of this project, applicants must be eligible to obtain the required national security clearances.
  
Öppen för alla
  
Vi fokuserar på din kompetens, inte dina övriga förutsättningar. Vi är öppna för att anpassa rollen eller arbetsplatsen efter dina behov.

title: Lead Manufacturing Engineer
description:
As a Lead Manufacturing Engineer, you will play a key role in bringing new products from concept to production by leading manufacturing activities throughout the New Product Introduction (NPI) process. You will collaborate closely with Engineering, Development, Production, and external suppliers to design, industrialize, and continuously improve manufacturing processes for electromechanical products. This role offers the opportunity to influence product manufacturability, drive automation initiatives, and support operational excellence in a highly collaborative environment.


**In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:**

* Lead manufacturing activities within New Product Introduction (NPI) projects, ensuring successful transition from product development to production.
* Collaborate with Engineering and Development teams to incorporate Design for Manufacturing (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA) principles early in the product development process.
* Define manufacturing equipment requirements, prepare technical specifications, evaluate supplier proposals, and support supplier selection activities.
* Develop and maintain manufacturing documentation, including work instructions, production standards, tooling concepts, line layouts, and test procedures.
* Plan, coordinate, and support Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT), Site Acceptance Tests (SAT), and production ramp-up activities.
* Drive process improvements and support the migration of legacy products to more efficient, scalable, automated, and digitalized manufacturing solutions.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to identify and implement manufacturing improvements that enhance quality, productivity, and operational performance.
* Support automation initiatives and collaborate with external equipment suppliers and machine builders to develop manufacturing solutions.
* Participate in global projects and provide manufacturing support to other Emerson sites when required.
Promote a culture of continuous improvement, safety, and operational excellence.  
* 

**Who You Are:**

You are a collaborative and proactive engineering professional who thrives in project-based environments. You build strong relationships across functions, communicate effectively with diverse stakeholders, and take ownership of delivering results. You are comfortable navigating technical challenges, identifying opportunities for improvement, and translating complex engineering requirements into practical manufacturing solutions. With a strong customer and business focus, you continuously seek ways to improve processes, drive innovation, and support organizational success.


**For This Role, You Will Need:**

* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Production Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
* Minimum 3-5 years of experience in a manufacturing or industrial engineering environment.
* Experience supporting manufacturing activities within product development or New Product Introduction (NPI) projects.
* Strong technical understanding of electromechanical products and manufacturing processes.
* Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, specifications, and engineering documentation.
* Experience working in cross-functional project teams and collaborating with multiple stakeholders.
* Fluency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.
* Experience using CAD tools, Microsoft Office applications, and business/ERP systems.
* Strong communication, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a dynamic environment.  
* 

**Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:**

* Experience as a Manufacturing Engineer, Production Engineer, Industrialization Engineer, or similar role.
* Experience working with electromechanical assemblies and production systems.
* Knowledge of Design for Manufacturing (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA) methodologies.
* Experience planning and executing FAT and SAT activities for manufacturing equipment.
* Knowledge of PFMEA, control plans, process validation, and manufacturing test strategies.
* Experience defining automation requirements and collaborating with machine builders or equipment suppliers.
* Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing principles and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Experience supporting process automation, digitalization, and manufacturing transformation initiatives.
* Experience working within stage-gate or structured product development processes.
Ability to create or modify technical drawings using CAD tools.  
* 

**Our Culture and Commitment To You:**

We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives—because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results.
  

  

You’ll find us at our Innovation Center in Mölnlycke, just 10 minutes from Gothenburg, easily accessible by car, bike and public transport. Here, every employee is part of a dynamic and innovative environment where everyone understands how their work contributes to the success of our company.


At the office, you can enjoy access to our gym and share great lunches with colleagues in our restaurant. Customer focus, engagement, and courage are at the heart of our culture. We foster a friendly and positive atmosphere, and as part of a global organization with locations around the world, you’ll have plenty of opportunities for personal and professional development.


  
**WHY EMERSON**

At Emerson, we are motivated by a spirit of collaboration that helps our diverse, multicultural teams across the world drive innovation that makes the world healthier, safer, smarter, and more sustainable. And we want you to join us in our bold aspiration.

title: Thesis Work – Investigating the environmental impact of AI & Future Technologies at ABB Robotics
description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.


This role sits within ABB's Robotics business, a leading global robotics company. We're entering an exciting new chapter as we’ve announced the plan for SoftBank Group to acquire ABB Robotics. SoftBank is a globally recognized technology group and investor/operator focused on AI, robotics, and next-generation computing. By joining us now, you’ll be part of a pioneering team shaping the future of robotics—working alongside world-class experts in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment.


This Position reports to:


R&D Global Unit Lead  

Are you interested in sustainability? Are you interested in analyzing the environmental impact of AI and software? Then come do a thesis with us at ABB Robotics!


ABB Robotics is a leading supplier of industrial robots and robot software, in addition to its equipment, and complete application solutions. We are found in 53 countries and have installed more than 500,000 robots, supported by the broadest service network, and offering in the industry.


Analyzing the environmental impact of a physical product is not new to ABB Robotics - we have Life Cycle Assessments for many of our physical robots for over 5 years. But as we peer into the future, it’s important to investigate how the environmental impact of ABB Robotics will evolve under the future technology of large, general-purpose AI models. Foundation models could improve the sustainability of robotics by allowing knowledge learned from large and diverse datasets to be reused across many robots and applications, reducing the need to develop and train separate models for every task. However, training and deploying these models can require substantial computational resources and energy.

**Your Role and Responsibilities**
----------------------------------


The candidate will develop a methodology to quantify the environmental impact (energy, water, etc) of the future technologies throughout the whole life cycle (training, architecture hardware, data cost, inference/sensing) and identify hotspots, potential rebound effects, and evaluate different future scenarios. For example, when does AI and future technologies become a more sustainable? And which types of deployment architectures are better? We are offering this exciting master thesis opportunity within R&D sustainability team.


We are a company with many future technology experts, and are looking for a curious sustainability specialist interested in assessing and discussing with us!

***Details:***

* *January-June 2027*
* *30 ECTS/högskolepoäng(hp)*
* *One student*
* *Distance/On site in Västerås*

**Your responsibilites**
------------------------

* Literature study on the environmental impacts of AI and future technologies
* Deep dive into ABB Robotics' current set up
* Quantify the influence of AI and future technologies with a Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) using SimaPro Software
* Identifying the environmental hotspots
* Depending on interest and initial results, evaluate the different technical scenarios (deployment architecture, infrastructure, materials, inferences) and environmental scenarios (renewable energy, etc.)
* Document and provide recommendations for implementation
* Live ABB’s core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.

**Your background**
-------------------

* Engineering student in sustainability, environmental, or energy
* Knowledgeable about carbon footprints/LCAs and SimaPro
* Experience with Excel (PowerBi and VBA interesting, but not necessary)
* Curious, self-driven, structured and analytical mindset.
* Fluent English in speaking and writing, English is the corporate language and used for all documentation
* Ability to work independently while collaborating with the team

title: Senior Medical Device Quality & Regulatory Engineer
description:
**Senior Medical Device Quality & Regulatory Engineer**
=======================================================


At **Flow Neuroscience**, we’re building the future of mental health treatment — combining neuroscience, hardware, and software to deliver clinically proven, non-drug therapy at scale.


Our flagship product, the Flow FL-100, is an at-home treatment for major depressive disorder, one of the leading causes of disability worldwide. It is the first neuromodulation treatment FDA-approved as a standalone, at-home treatment for major depressive disorder.  

  

Following regulatory approvals in Europe, UK, Australia, and the US, we’re entering a new phase of growth — scaling manufacturing, strengthening our quality systems, and expanding globally.


We’re now looking for a Senior Medical Device Quality Assurance & Regulatory Engineer to take a central role in maintaining and evolving our QA, QMS, and regulatory infrastructure.

**The Role**
------------


You will own and drive critical parts of our quality and regulatory framework across the full product lifecycle — from design and development through manufacturing at our contract manufacturers, post-market, and supporting regulatory submissions. You will act as the technical owner for key product lifecycle and quality processes, driving cross-functional projects across R&D, manufacturing, quality and regulatory.


This is a high-impact role at the intersection of engineering, manufacturing, quality, and regulatory strategy. You will be embedded within our technical teams and work closely with Quality, Regulatory, and Supply Chain.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Lead and maintain Design Control processes (design history file, verification/validation, risk management, device change control)
* Own and maintain Technical Documentation / Technical Files / DHFs / DMRs
* Drive supplier qualification, auditing, and ongoing manufacturing quality control and improvements
* Collaborate closely with R&D on design changes and process improvements
* Support and continuously improve our ISO 13485-certified QMS
* Support regulatory submissions and updates (EU MDR, FDA)
* Ensure compliance with evolving regulations, including FDA QMSR, EU and UK MDR changes
* Support audits (Notified Body, FDA, suppliers, internal) and inspection readiness
* Work cross-functionally with product, regulatory, and operations teams

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------


You’re someone who understands both the letter of the regulations and the reality of building a product in a fast-moving company. You have a strong technical background in either medical-device software or hardware/product engineering, combined with hands-on experience in medical-device design, development and manufacturing.

### **Core Competencies**

* Very strong technical project management skills
* Strong technical experience with active medical devices
* Strong understanding of design and development controls under ISO 13485 and FDA QMSR (21 CFR Part 820)
* Hands-on experience with supplier and manufacturing quality control
* Proven experience managing Technical Files / DHF / DMR
* Expertise in ISO 13485 QMS implementation and maintenance
* Experience with FDA regulations (QMSR) and EU MDR
* Experience with FDA inspections and/or Notified Body audits

### **Bonus (Highly Valuable)**

* Experience with FDA PMA devices (Class III) and PMA supplements
* Background in combination hardware/software medical devices
* Quality management system automation, eQMS & AI-tools.
* Experience working closely with Asia-based contract manufacturers
* Experience working with neurotech.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* You take ownership and operate with high autonomy
* You’re structured, detail-oriented, and pragmatic
* You can translate regulatory requirements into efficient processes
* You enjoy working cross-functionally with engineers and operators
* You’re comfortable in a scaling environment where not everything is fully defined, and you enjoy building the processes and systems that are missing

**Why join us?**
----------------

* Work on a clinically proven treatment for one of the world’s largest health problems
* Be part of a company transitioning into global scale (including the US market)
* Own meaningful parts of the quality and regulatory backbone of a US Class III device
* Join a mission-driven team combining science, engineering, and real-world impact

  

Location: Hybrid. Skåne, Sweden, or London, UK.  

You will be expected to work from one of our offices a few times per week.

title: MEMS Electrical Test Engineer
description:
Silex is investing strategically in MEMS testing as a core capability to strengthen our position in the market and deliver industry-leading solutions to our customers. As part of this effort, we are expanding our MEMS test infrastructure, methodologies, and expertise. This is a unique opportunity to be part of a forward-looking initiative that will define the next generation of MEMS performance and reliability.

  


#### **About the role**


We are looking for a professional with a strong focus on test engineering and hands-on experience with test equipment and measurements, and related software development.


You will join a growing and collaborative engineering team dedicated to developing advanced test solutions that support the full product lifecycle – from early prototypes to high-volume manufacturing. As a MEMS Test Engineer, you will play a key role in developing, optimizing, and executing test systems – both hardware and software – for a broad range of MEMS products, ensuring performance meets customer specifications and industry standards. You will collaborate cross-functionally within Silex and communicate with both suppliers and customers.  

  



**In this role you will:**


* Design and implement test solutions based on MEMS device specifications, covering electrical, optical, and mechanical performance.
* Develop and validate test cases and procedures for both manual and automated wafer-level and die-level test systems.
* Select, configure, and maintain specialized test instrumentation, including probe stations, precision source-measure units (SMUs), oscilloscopes, and custom MEMS test fixtures.
* Perform hands-on testing in both cleanroom and laboratory environments, ensuring proper handling of sensitive MEMS devices and adherence to ESD and contamination-control procedures.
* Analyze and interpret test data to evaluate device performance, identify trends, and diagnose issues at both the device and system level.
* Collaborate closely with design, process, and product engineers to troubleshoot, optimize test coverage, and improve product yield and reliability.
* Thoroughly document all test plans, configurations, and results to ensure full traceability and enable continuous improvement in test methods and equipment.
* Drive improvements in throughput, automation, and measurement accuracy across the MEMS test process flow.
* Ensure all activities comply with quality standards, customer requirements, and relevant industry regulations.

**We are looking for someone who has**


* A Masters degree or Ph.D. in Engineering, preferably in Electrical Engineering, Engineering Physics, or a related field.
* At least 3 years of experience in electrical measurements, device characterization, or production tests – ideally including MEMS or semiconductor tests within an industrial environment or academia.
* Experience in LabVIEW programming for test automation, instrument control, and data acquisition. Proficiency in Python and familiarity with SQL databases for data analysis, visualization and structured data management.
* Hands-on experience with a wide range of test equipment, such as source-measure units (SMUs), parametric analyzers, probe stations, oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, and other specialized tools used in MEMS testing.
* Experience in cleanroom or controlled laboratory environments.
* Strong analytical mindset and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex device- and system-level issues.
* Basic knowledge or experience in 3D CAD modeling and prototype manufacturing methods (e.g., 3D printing, CNC machining) for test fixture design and development.

#### **What we offer you**


* Collaboration with a team of exceptional colleagues who share your passion for technology.
* Opportunities to work with cutting-edge MEMS technology in a state-of-the-art environment.
* Being part of a world-leading company that drives innovation and shapes the future of MEMS development.
* Continuous knowledge sharing with global experts in MEMS process integration and development.

#### **About Silex**


Silex is the world’s largest and most advanced pure-play MEMS foundry, headquartered in Stockholm. MEMS is present in nearly all modern technology, from personal gadgets to automotive electronics, medical monitoring and testing equipment, and thermal management systems. With a team of expert engineers, operators, technicians, support staff, specialists, and more, Silex brings the ideas and concepts of the industry’s leading MEMS innovators to life.


The Silex team brings together talented, curious, visionary, and determined individuals to break new ground in the industry alongside customers, developing the latest process technology within MEMS for global applications. As part of this team, you will work with some of the world’s largest technology giants and innovation leaders in industries such as medicine, life sciences, consumer electronics, telecommunications, automotive, and industrial sectors.


#### **The recruitment process**


We have an ongoing recruitment process and therefore encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. To apply, please attach your CV and answer a few questions. Our process is competency-based and includes a personality and logic test as well as reference checks. Additionally, we will conduct a background check and drug test prior to employment, and as an employer, we perform random alcohol and drug tests for all employees.

title: Robotics Test Engineer – GNSS / Positioning
description:
Do you want to work with **autonomous robots and advanced positioning technologies**?


We are looking for a **Robotics Test Engineer – GNSS / Positioning** to join the **Automower R&D team in Jönköping**. In this role you will work hands-on with testing and validating how our robotic lawn mowers navigate in real-world environments.


You will collaborate closely with developers and engineers to ensure that our **positioning systems are accurate, robust and ready for real customer environments**.

**Why this role is exciting**


Positioning and navigation are among the **most critical capabilities in autonomous robotics**.


In this role, you will work directly with the technologies that allow our robots to **know exactly where they are and move efficiently in complex outdoor environments**.


Your work will directly impact how **next-generation Automower products perform in real life**.

**Technologies you will work with**

* GNSS / RTK / EPOS positioning
* Python scripting and test automation
* Robotics navigation systems
* Log and positioning data analysis
* Automated regression testing

**What you will do**


As a **Robotics Test Engineer**, your focus will be to test and validate positioning performance in real-world environments.


Your responsibilities will include:

* Testing **RTK/GNSS positioning performance** in different outdoor environments
* Performing **hands-on field testing** in test areas and outdoor environments
* Identifying and investigating positioning deviations such as drift or loss of fix
* Analyzing **logs and positioning data** to isolate root causes
* Designing and executing tests based on field observations and development needs
* Contributing to **automated regression testing** of positioning functions
* Collaborating closely with developers and system engineers
* Supporting **test planning, documentation and release readiness**

**We think you might have**

* Around **2–3 years of experience** working with positioning technologies such as **GNSS or RTK**
* Experience with **testing, log analysis or technical troubleshooting**
* Knowledge of **Python scripting**
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

title: Senior Security Engineer
description:
**Join our global force of 400+ innovators, blending the latest in tech with the greatest in soundtracking, from our Stockholm HQ to offices in London, New York, Los Angeles, Berlin, Paris, Oslo, and Seoul. We’re an industry leader with a startup mentality. We take what we do seriously, but we don’t take ourselves too seriously. Creating and collaborating to transform the sound of streaming, content, and culture. Come join us, and let the world** 
***feel***
**your work.**
 As a Security Engineer at Epidemic Sound, you will help keep the company safe across three connected surfaces: the products our customers use, the platform our engineers build on, and the systems our employees rely on every day. This is a broad, generalist role where your work directly shapes how an industry-leading company with a startup mentality manages risk and builds securely at scale.
   

  

 Building security automations and custom AI agents is a normal part of how the team operates, and you will be expected to do the same. You will sit within the Business Tech Division and report to the Head of Security, working closely with engineers, SRE, IT, Legal, and People teams across the organisation.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities Include**
* Own the vulnerability management programme across our products, cloud, and corporate estate: discovery, prioritisation, remediation tracking, and reporting.
* Consolidate findings across our detection stack into a single risk picture.
* Partner with software engineers to grow the Secure Software Development Lifecycle, including code reviews, threat models, and pre-ship security input.
* Harden the GCP estate, Kubernetes platform, and CI/CD systems our engineers depend on.
* Run vendor security reviews and respond to enterprise customer security questionnaires.
* Operate and tune the Elastic SIEM and broader detection stack, building new detections as the threat picture evolves.
* Respond to security incidents including on-call, and run training exercises to keep the team ready.
* Build and run security agents and automations that other engineers and the wider business rely on, treating them as production-grade software.
* Evaluate AI models and frameworks against security standards.


**Requirements**
* Around five years in security engineering, with depth in at least one of application security, infrastructure security, enterprise security, or vulnerability management, and solid breadth across the others.
* Hands-on experience running or contributing to a vulnerability management programme, including prioritisation, SLA setting, remediation tracking, and reporting.
* Working knowledge of SCA/SAST tooling, Internal Developer Portals, and SIEM; we use Snyk, Port, and Elastic.
* Working knowledge of the security features of the major public cloud providers, with GCP preferred.
* Comfort with Kubernetes, Docker, or other container architectures.
* Confident with at least one programming or scripting language such as Python, Go, or Bash.
* Solid experience with Git, GitHub Actions, and Terraform.
* Active, daily use of AI and agentic tools, with concrete examples of agents you have built and outputs you have shipped.
* Experience with vendor security questionnaires.
* Familiarity with common security frameworks such as PCI DSS and NIST.


**It would also be music to our ears if you have**
* Penetration testing background or OWASP Top 10 fluency.
* Experience with CI/CD security hardening at scale.
* A track record of building security tools other engineers want to use.
* Experience reporting vulnerability management and security posture metrics to leadership.
* Familiarity with social engineering attacks, especially phishing, and the controls that reduce them.


**Equal opportunity employer**
 We believe that bringing people together from different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives makes for a healthy workplace, a more successful business and a better world. We value diversity and encourage everyone to come and soundtrack the world with us.
   

  

**Application**
 Ready to make the world
 *feel* 
 your work? Please apply, in English.
